new_roles.title: Senior Consultant, Quality (VP-Level)
new_roles.description:
This individual will serve as an integral consultant with exposure to multiple facets of business operations. The **Senior Consultant, Quality** will be responsible for helping to set strategic direction and operational oversight of the quality function addressing all aspects of GXP compliance.This consultant ensures all internal processes and external partnerships strictly adhere to global regulatory standards, including FDA, EMA, and ICH guidelines.

**This role can be up to 10 hours per week to start.**

 

Elicio (ELTX) is a growing organization based out of the Seaport area of Boston, Massachusetts with additional staff functioning in a virtual based environment from the Greater Boston area and throughout the United States.

 

**Key Responsibilities Include**

 

* **Strategic Leadership:**Develop and execute a comprehensive quality and compliance vision that aligns with the company’s clinical and commercial objectives.
* **Quality Management System (QMS):**Design, implement, and maintain a robust QMS—including document control, change management, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) systems—that scales with the company's growth.
* **GxP Compliance Oversight:**Ensure full compliance across all GxP areas, including Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Clinical Practices (GCP), and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP).
* **Regulatory Interaction:**Serve as the primary liaison for regulatory health authorities during inspections and audits; lead the strategy for inspection readiness.
* **External Partner Management:**Oversee quality at external vendors, including contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs) and clinical research organizations (CROs), ensuring consistent quality standards and negotiating quality agreements.
* **Product Disposition:**Hold ultimate accountability for the review and release (disposition) of raw materials, intermediates, and final drug products for both clinical trials and commercial sale.
* **Culture & Talent:**Build and mentor a high-performing quality organization while championing a "Quality First" culture across all departments.

 

**Education & Professional Experience**

 

* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or technical discipline (e.g., Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy) is required. An advanced degree (MS, PhD, or MBA) is strongly preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive leadership in quality within the biotech or pharmaceutical industry.
* Deep knowledge of global regulatory frameworks (FDA 21 CFR Part 11, 210/211, and ISO standards) and experience in biologics or small molecule manufacturing, and parenteral products. Experience with peptide-based vaccines is a plus.
* Proven track record of managing outsourced operations successfully leading organizations through regulatory inspections and commercial product launches.
* Must thrive in a fast-paced innovative start-up environment.
* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills for interacting with executive teams and regulatory agencies.
* Strong risk management and analytical problem-solving abilities.
* Strategic thinking with a "hands-on" approach to building quality organizations and quality systems.

 

**Working Model**

**Weekly hours:** This role can be up to 10 hours per week to start. It may increase or decrease over time.

**Working Conditions:** Busy home office/office/laboratory environment with frequent deadlines and interruptions.

**Travel:** Travel may be required to the Company’s headquarters a few times per year, if necessary.

**Physical Requirements:** Subject to periods of sitting or standing, vision is required to monitor data.

**Work Location:** Hybrid preference but will consider remote

**About Elicio Therapeutics**

Elicio Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: ELTX) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company advancing a pipeline of novel lymph node-targeted immunotherapies for the treatment of some of the most aggressive cancers. By combining expertise in immunology and immunotherapy, Elicio is harnessing the natural power of the immune system with the AMP technology, which allows for therapeutic payloads to be delivered directly to the lymph nodes, with the goal of enhancing the immune system’s cancer-fighting capabilities. By targeting cancer immunotherapies to the core of the immune response, AMP aims to optimize the lymph nodes’ natural ability to educate, activate and amplify cancer-specific T cells, which are essential for recognizing and eliminating tumor cells. Engineered to synchronize immunity in these highly potent sites, AMP is built to enhance the magnitude, potency, quality and durability of the immune response to drive antitumor activity. The Company’s R&D pipeline includes off-the-shelf therapeutic cancer vaccines ELI-002, (targeting mKRAS-driven cancers) as well as ELI-007 and ELI-008 (targeting BRAF-driven cancers and p53 hotspot mutations, respectively). For more information, please visit www.elicio.com.

**About the Amphiphile Platform**

 

Elicio Therapeutics’ proprietary Amphiphile (“AMP”) platform delivers investigational immunotherapeutics directly to the “brain center” of the immune system – the lymph nodes. Elicio believes this site-specific delivery of disease-specific antigens, adjuvants and other immunomodulators may efficiently educate, activate, and amplify critical immune cells, potentially resulting in induction and persistence of potent adaptive immunity required to treat many diseases. In preclinical models, Elicio has observed lymph node-specific engagement driving therapeutic immune responses of increased magnitude, function and durability. Elicio believes our AMP lymph node-targeted approach will produce superior clinical benefits compared to immunotherapies that do not engage the lymph nodes based upon preclinical studies. Elicio’s AMP platform, originally developed at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology has broad potential in the cancer space to advance a number of development initiatives through internal activities, in-licensing arrangements or development collaborations and partnerships. The AMP platform has been shown to deliver immunotherapeutics directly to the lymph nodes by latching on to the protein albumin, found in the bloodstream, as it travels to lymphatic tissue. In preclinical models, Elicio has observed lymph node-specific engagement driving immune responses of increased magnitude, function and durability.

new_roles.title: Director, Manufacturing Operations & Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
**Lead the Operation. Elevate the System. Grow the People.**
============================================================

Imagine starting your day on the production floor—checking safety, huddling with supervisors, scanning your ERP dashboard, and walking a focused gemba to spot the next opportunity. By afternoon, you're aligning capacity plans to customer demand, unblocking material flow, and celebrating wins from a cross-functional Kaizen. This is the rhythm of our Director, Manufacturing Operations & Continuous Improvement.

**Your Impact**
---------------

* Build, coach, and mentor a high-performing team of supervisors, leads, and skilled production personnel.
* Champion a culture that prizes safety, quality, accountability, and teamwork.
* Advance engagement through cross-training, development pathways, and clear performance expectations.
* Own production planning, scheduling, and capacity management to meet cost, quality, and delivery goals.
* Ensure on-time manufacturing and shipment while upholding rigorous quality standards.
* Lead Lean, Six Sigma, and CI roadmaps to lift throughput, reduce waste, and standardize best practices.
* Optimize processes to increase productivity and lower cost-to-serve.
* Manage material flow, inventory health, and operational KPIs end-to-end.
* Use ERP and data analytics to drive decisions and uncover improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with senior leadership on long-range manufacturing strategies and investments.
* Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional manufacturing talent.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, or a related technical field; or commensurate experience.
* 10+ years leading manufacturing operations with oversight of multiple production teams.
* Demonstrated success running large-scale operations and developing top-performing teams.
* Deep experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Quality Systems, and continuous improvement.
* Hands-on expertise with ERP, production planning, scheduling, and inventory management.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and sound decision-making skills.
* Excellent communicator and people leader.
* Proven ability to drive accountability while fostering a collaborative, positive workplace.

### **Preferred**

* Background in machining, welding, finishing, powder coating, assembly, or similar processes.
* Ability to read and interpret manufacturing drawings and specifications.
* History of improving productivity, quality, on-time delivery, and employee engagement.

**Who Thrives Here**
--------------------

A visible, floor-engaged leader who blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You enjoy solving problems shoulder-to-shoulder with your team and creating an environment where people perform, grow, and stay.

**About Amatrol**
-----------------

We equip learners and employers with hands-on training systems, interactive eLearning, simulators, curriculum, and certification resources that turn complex technology into practical skill. Our U.S.-made solutions serve schools, colleges, training centers, and industry across manufacturing, automation, robotics, electrical systems, oil and gas, packaging, and more—bridging learning and doing for today’s technical careers.

**Your Toolkit**
----------------

* Leadership / People Management
* Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
* Quality Control Experience
* Six Sigma Experience
* Production Planning & Scheduling
* Excellent Communication Skills
* Root Cause Analysis
* Process Development
* Blueprint Reading
* Microsoft Excel
* ERP Systems
* Hands On Leadership Style
* ISO 9001
* Manufacturing Leadership
* metal fabrication
* Microsoft Outlook
* Multiple Department Leadership
* Problem Solving
* Reporting
* Understanding Manufacturing Processes
* electronic assembly leadership

### **Tools You’ll Use**

* ERP Software

**Ready to Lead?**
------------------

If you’re eager to scale performance and build a best-in-class operation, we’d love to talk.

Please Note: This is a fully in-person position in Jeffersonville, IN. To be considered for this position, candidates must submit a current, chronological resume showing relevant work experience as well as a relevant digital portfolio. Contact Human Resources if you need any accommodations during the job application process due to a disability. Amatrol, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This position is not eligible for placement by outside recruitment or staffing agencies.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**U C Coatings Director of Operations**

**Reports to** President

**Location** Based at a U-C Coatings facility; Buffalo, NY or Kenosha, WI preferred

**Travel** Approximately 25-35%, including regular travel to all four sites and 3PL partners

**Scope** Buffalo, Kenosha, Seattle and Portland manufacturing sites; 3PLs; supply chain and sourcing; customer service

**Position summary**

U-C Coatings manufactures specialty coatings, wood protection and repair products for industrial and consumer markets. The **Director of Operations** leads the people, processes and resources that turn customer demand into safe, reliable production and accurate, timely delivery.

Reporting to the President, this leader is accountable for operating performance across four sites and the supporting supply chain, sourcing, logistics and customer service functions. The role requires regular time on the production floor, strong financial judgment, and the ability to develop capable site and functional leaders in a lean organization.

**Manufacturing and site leadership**

* Lead site leaders in Buffalo, NY, Kenosha, WI, Seattle, WA, and Portland, OR; establish clear responsibilities, operating standards and performance expectations across the network.
* Translate demand into production, staffing and capacity plans; improve batch scheduling, filling, packaging, labor productivity and equipment utilization.
* Improve yield, reduce scrap and rework, and address recurring downtime through preventive maintenance, root cause analysis and practical process improvements.
* Evaluate production allocation, interplant transfers, capital investments and facility changes to improve service, cost and available capacity.

**Supply chain and sourcing**

* Own procurement and supplier performance for raw materials, packaging, purchased products and operating supplies; negotiate pricing, terms and service commitments.
* Lead monthly demand and supply planning with Sales and Finance; align forecasts, purchasing and production with service goals and working capital requirements.
* Set replenishment and inventory policies by item and site; improve inventory accuracy, reduce excess and obsolete stock, and prevent material shortages.
* Develop qualified alternate sources and continuity plans for critical inputs; coordinate supplier and material changes with Technical and Quality before implementation.

**Logistics and third party warehousing**

* Manage 3PL contracts, service standards and performance reviews, including inventory reconciliation, order accuracy, shipping performance, claims and invoice audits.
* Control inbound, outbound, parcel, LTL and interplant freight costs; improve packaging, carrier selection and routing while meeting customer requirements.

**Customer Service**

* Lead Customer Service from order receipt through fulfillment; improve order entry accuracy, acknowledgments, delivery commitments and response times.
* Connect Customer Service, Sales, planning, plants and 3PLs so customers receive reliable commitments and proactive updates on shortages or delays.
* Resolve escalated service issues, returns and credits with Sales, Finance and Technical; use complaint and shipping error trends to eliminate repeat failures.

**Safety quality and compliance**

* Hold site leaders accountable for safe operations, training, inspections, incident reporting and timely corrective action; maintain clear escalation and stop-work authority.
* Partner with internal specialists and outside advisers to meet applicable workplace safety, environmental, storage, waste and shipping requirements at each site.
* Ensure operating teams follow approved formulations, batch records, quality checks, labeling and lot traceability; support product launches and process changes with Technical and Quality.

**Financial management and people leadership**

* Own operating budgets and explain labor, material, freight and overhead variances with Finance; deliver verified savings and capital projects with clear returns.
* Coach and evaluate site and functional leaders; build staffing, cross-training and succession plans, and address performance issues promptly with HR support.
* Run weekly site and consolidated scorecard reviews covering service, cost, quality, inventory and people; assign owners and deadlines and verify corrective actions.

**Qualifications**

* Ten or more years of progressive manufacturing operations experience, including at least five years leading managers or major operating functions.
* Demonstrated success leading multiple manufacturing sites or a comparably complex manufacturing and distribution network; ability to lead dispersed teams.
* Practical experience with procurement, inventory planning, logistics, outsourced warehousing and customer fulfillment; strong cost and financial analysis skills.
* Experience with ERP and MRP systems, Excel, operating scorecards and continuous improvement; ability to turn data into decisions and sustained results.
* Bachelor's degree in operations, supply chain, engineering, business or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Coatings, chemicals, adhesives, sealants or other batch manufacturing experience is strongly preferred.

**Measures of success**

Accountable measures include safety controls; on-time, in-full delivery; labor efficiency; yield and cost of poor quality; inventory accuracy and turns; supplier and 3PL performance; freight costs; order accuracy; and leadership development. Agree on targets with the CEO after validating baselines.

**Initial priorities and working environment**

Within 90 days, assess the sites and key partners, validate scorecards, and agree on an improvement plan with owners, deadlines and financial impact. Work includes office, plant and warehouse activities, required PPE (company-provided), regular travel and occasional support outside business hours. Essential duties may be performed with reasonable accommodation.

**COMPANY DESCRIPTION:**

U-C Coatings is a leading manufacturer and supplier of premium wood protection products. For more than 50 years, our products have been used in a variety of industries, including hardwood and softwood logging and lumber production, wood products, manufacturing, woodworking, and wood decking markets.

Our products are used worldwide to protect, conserve, and enhance forest resources. Our goal is to help our customers achieve more with less waste and provide the highest level of protection for their products.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

This role is an in-person role located within the company’s Kenosha, WI location. There is a moderate noise level within the work environment. Compliance with applicable Company policies including maintaining a drug-free workplace and adhering to all safety policies and procedures is required.

**DISCLAIMERS:**

UC Coatings, LLC reserves the right to revise, change or modify the duties and responsibilities of this position at any time to meet business needs. This job description may not list all duties for this position. This job description is not a contract of employment, and all UC Coatings, LLC employment unless otherwise disclosed is “at will” and either the incumbent or UC Coatings, LLC may terminate employment at any time for any reason.

UC Coatings, LLC is an Equal opportunity, inclusive employer and will consider all applicants for employment with the Company based on merit, competence, and qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Operations management: 5 years (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

new_roles.title: Contract Manufacturing Director
new_roles.description:
**Lassonde Pappas & Co.** is a US Leader in beverage manufacturing dedicated to our team members, customers and consumers satisfaction. We remain committed to our small-town roots and rural values. **Hardworking** and **caring** are qualities that make our teams special. Since 1942, we’ve been producing delicious products for our customers across the country!

To provide the best for our customers, we focus on building the best team by creating and advancing an inclusive environment amongst our diverse workforces. If you’re passionate about customer satisfaction, reliable, and committed to being and doing better, join us!

**We value each of our employees’ total wellbeing. To support employees in all stages of their wellness journey, we have a robust benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage options, growth and development potential, along with 401-K, Life & Disability Insurance, PTO, Tuition Reimbursement, Health Fairs, Gym Membership Discounts, and so much more!**

*Pay Range for this position is: $165,000-$200,000 plus annual bonus, depending on experience and geographical location.*

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The **Director, Contract Manufacturing** reports to the Vice President, Integrated Planning, U.S. Beverage and is based in Cherry Hill, New Jersey.

The Director is responsible for defining the role of contract manufacturing within the Beverage Division’s broader supply network and translating business plans into clear external capacity, capability, geographic, and partnership requirements across the U.S. and Canada. This role leads the development and optimization of the contract manufacturing network to ensure the right capabilities, capacity, cost, quality, service, and resilience to support business growth.

The Director oversees relationships with contract manufacturing partners from initial capability assessment and commercial selection through operational integration, product launch, ongoing governance, and continuous performance improvement.

The Director aligns internal business and functional leaders around external manufacturing decisions and builds productive relationships with strategic partners. The role ensures that external manufacturing resources are positioned to support the division’s growth plans, innovation agenda, service expectations, cost objectives, and business continuity requirements.

**Up to 25% travel required**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**External Manufacturing Strategy & Network Optimization**

* Define and execute the contract manufacturing strategy for the Beverage Division across the U.S. and Canada, translating business requirements into external manufacturing capacity, capability, geographic, and partnership needs.
* Optimize the existing contract manufacturing network by assessing manufacturing capabilities, capacity, geographic footprint, technology, cost, service, quality, and supply risk.
* Partner with Integrated Planning, Operations, Finance, Procurement, and other key stakeholders on make-versus-buy decisions and long-term capacity strategies.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the external manufacturing landscape to identify new capabilities, technologies, potential partners, and opportunities to strengthen the overall supply network.

**Strategic Sourcing & Commercial Management**

* Translate business requirements into sourcing strategies for externally manufactured products, balancing economics, available capacity, technical capability, speed, flexibility, and supply risk.
* Lead competitive sourcing and partner-selection activities, including market assessment, RFIs/RFPs/RFQs, commercial evaluation, supplier selection, negotiation, contracting, and implementation.
* Structure and negotiate commercial agreements that clearly define pricing, capacity commitments, service expectations, quality requirements, flexibility provisions, liability, and business continuity obligations.
* Develop fact-based sourcing recommendations considering total cost of ownership, capacity, capability, risk, and overall strategic fit.
* Establish pricing mechanisms and commercial frameworks that promote transparency, competitiveness, and sustainable productivity.
* Provide financial stewardship of external manufacturing spend through disciplined budgeting, forecasting, cost analysis, variance management, and productivity delivery.

**Supplier Relationship & Performance Management**

* Establish and lead a structured Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) approach for strategic contract manufacturing partners.
* Establish and maintain a robust performance management framework and supplier scorecards for the contract manufacturing network.
* Establish a disciplined operating rhythm with strategic partners, supported by agreed performance measures, periodic operating and executive business reviews, documented recovery plans, and clear ownership of actions.
* Build strategic relationships with key external manufacturing partners to improve service, strengthen capacity and flexibility, accelerate innovation, and identify productivity opportunities.
* Lead supplier and network risk assessments and ensure appropriate business continuity, contingency, and risk mitigation plans are developed and maintained.

The Director owns the performance framework for the external manufacturing network, ensuring that targets reflect the division’s priorities for customer service, product quality, delivered cost, productivity, available capacity, launch execution, contractual compliance, and supply continuity. The role is responsible for converting performance information into timely decisions, recovery actions, and clear visibility of results and risks for business leadership.

**Commercialization & Cross-Functional Execution**

* Lead the external manufacturing workstream for new product commercialization, capacity expansions, product transfers, and new contract manufacturer onboarding.
* Partner with R&D, Marketing, Quality, Engineering, Operations, Integrated Planning, and other key functions to ensure new products and external manufacturing capabilities are launched on time, at target cost, and in accordance with quality and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure effective integration of contract manufacturers into the broader planning and supply network, including capacity planning, production planning, inventory management, service, and supply continuity.
* Coordinate resolution of operational and supply issues across internal functions and external manufacturing partners, ensuring clear ownership and escalating material business risks when required.

**Team Leadership & Governance**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Contract Manufacturing team, establishing clear goals, accountability, and individual development plans.
* Establish the governance, processes, tools, decision rights, and performance standards required to effectively manage the external manufacturing network.
* Ensure accurate and actionable contract manufacturing information is maintained, including supplier capabilities, capacity, pricing, commercial terms, products/SKUs, performance, and contractual commitments.
* Provide business leadership with regular visibility into external manufacturing cost, capacity, service, performance, supply risk, and opportunities, enabling timely and informed decision-making.
* Drive cross-functional alignment and accountability for initiatives and decisions affecting the external manufacturing network.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

**Minimum Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in contract manufacturing, external manufacturing, strategic sourcing, procurement, operations, or supply chain, preferably within the CPG, food, or beverage industry.
* Demonstrated experience managing third-party manufacturing relationships and complex commercial agreements.
* Strong experience in strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations, contracting, and supplier relationship management.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving Operations, Planning, Quality, R&D, Finance, Procurement, and Commercial teams.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate cost, capacity, capability, service, quality, and supply risk and translate analysis into effective business recommendations.
* Strong financial and analytical acumen, including experience with budgeting, forecasting, cost modeling, and productivity initiatives.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and external business partners within a complex matrix organization.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and change-management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the food, beverage, or broader CPG industry.
* Experience managing a multi-site or North American external manufacturing network.
* Experience with new product commercialization, manufacturing transfers, and external partner onboarding.
* APICS/ASCM certification, CPSM, or comparable supply chain/procurement certification.
* MBA or advanced degree.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Directly manages three employees, providing coaching, development, performance management, and clear accountability for results.
* Establishes team priorities, objectives, and performance expectations aligned with the contract manufacturing strategy and broader business goals.
* Builds team capability and expertise while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and results.
* Provides leadership across a broader cross-functional network, influencing internal stakeholders and external manufacturing partners to achieve service, quality, cost, capacity, innovation, and supply continuity objectives.
* Leads through influence across a matrix organization, driving alignment and accountability among internal functions and strategic external partners.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORKING CONDITIONS**

This position requires sufficient physical ability to work in a typical office setting; driving a motor vehicle, taking the plane, doing north American travel and occasionally working in the field.

**FREQUENT:** sitting, upward and downward flexion of neck; fine finger dexterity and light to moderate finger pressure to include extended periods of keyboard and mouse use, side-to-side turning of neck, walking, standing, bending and stooping, pushing/pulling, twisting at waist, moderate wrist torque to twist equipment knobs and dials.

**OCCASIONAL:** squatting, kneeling, reach above and at shoulder height, moderate grasp to manipulate reference books and manuals; lifting objects weighing 20 – 35 lbs. from below waist to above shoulders and transporting distances up to 50 feet.

**VISION:** Ability to see in the normal visual range with or without correction.

**HEARING:** Ability to hear in the normal audio range with or without correction.

**This job description is not intended to contain a comprehensive list of the responsibilities that are required to successfully perform in this position. Other duties as assigned are part of every job description. The conditions herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform essential job functions.**

**Lassonde Pappas & Co., Inc provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.**

**This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.**

new_roles.title: Director of Quality & Compliance
new_roles.description:
Exciting leadership opportunity with a growing skin care manufacturing company. At Episciences, the Director of Quality and Compliance is responsible for ensuring the marketing compliance of topical skin care products domestically and internationally and has oversight of manufacturing quality assurance and control processes in-house and at third party testing facilities. The ideal candidate will have working knowledge/experience of FDA cosmetic and OTC drug regulations; EU, UK, and Canada cosmetic regulations; and cGMP. The Director of Quality and Compliance routinely monitors current and new regulations to ensure products are compliant within all intended markets.

As the head of the Quality Control and Assurance team, the Director of Quality and Compliance is responsible for the review/approval and maintenance of master product formulae, master labeling copies and maintenance of standard operating procedures. The Director of Quality and Compliance also reviews and trends: customer complaints, raw materials, quality processes and finished product testing for release to Manufacturing,

Ideal Qualifications for this Position:

* Bachelor’s degree in chemistry is preferred

* 5+ years of management experience is preferred

* 5+ years of experience in food, drug and/or cosmetic manufacturing GMPs and Regulatory

* Ability to read and comprehend FDA CFRs as well as other domestic and international Regulatory documentation

* Excellent communication and presentation skills

* Excellent organization, filing and document writing skills

* FDA audit experience is a plus

What to expect as the Director of Quality and Compliance at Episciences Inc.:

* Discounted award-winning Episciences Inc. products

* A Business Casual Company and Culture

* Company paid medical, dental, vision and life insurance coverages

* Company matching retirement plan

* Paid holidays (11 per calendar year)

* Vacation and PTO accrual

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Director of Operations**

**Livingston County Water and Sewer Authority | Lakeville, New York**

**Salary:$110,000-$130,000 | First Review: December 4, 2026**

**Lead Essential Operations. Develop the Workforce. Prepare for Growth.**

The Livingston County Water and Sewer Authority (LCWSA) is seeking an experienced water and wastewater operations professional to help guide its operations through a period of significant growth and expansion.

Over the past five years, the Authority has expanded its water system by 20% while assuming responsibility for additional treatment facilities. With further growth anticipated, LCWSA is investing in its infrastructure, operations, and workforce to meet increasing demands.

The Director of Operations oversees the Authority's water distribution and sewer collection systems, including maintenance activities, field resources, staff development, regulatory compliance, and a $3.5 million operating budget.

**The Opportunity**

The next Director of Operations will help prepare LCWSA for continued expansion while strengthening daily operations and developing its workforce. Priorities include preventive maintenance, infrastructure planning, effective use of operational resources, and training and mentoring employees as experienced team members approach retirement.

LCWSA seeks a collaborative, hands-on leader who combines practical field experience and technical expertise with sound judgment, organizational skills, and a commitment to staff development. new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
The Director, Operational Excellence, is a hands-on practitioner who supports ESCO sites in deploying the **ESCO Operating System (EOS)**. The person in this role travels to sites to facilitate Kaizen events, take part in key EOS activities, and coach site leaders and teams to strengthen EOS adoption, practice, and results.

Site Presidents and site EOS Managers own and lead EOS deployment at their sites. This role supports them as an experienced practitioner and member of a small central EOS team. The EOS Program Lead owns program strategy and the development of EOS elements, and a peer role owns data, tools, KPIs, and monthly business reviews. This role helps sites put EOS standards into practice on the floor and brings field learning back to improve those standards.

This is a director-level individual contributor role with no direct reports. It works through influence with site leaders and teams. The initial focus is the Aerospace & Defense group, with expansion to other ESCO divisions as EOS deployment grows.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Site Deployment Support***

* Support site Presidents and EOS Managers in executing their annual EOS deployment plans toward EOS maturity certifications.
* Participate in key EOS activities during site visits, such as MDI, Kaizen events, and Gemba Walks, and provide sites with direct feedback to enhance adoption and practice.
* Help sites put EOS elements into practice, including MDI, Gemba Walks, KPI management, action management, P&R, structured problem solving, and leader standard work.
* Provide sites with continued support to improve EOS adoption, sustainment, and results.

***Kaizen and Improvement Events***

* Plan and facilitate Kaizen events with site teams: scoping and chartering with site leadership, pre-event data collection, team training, current state analysis, implementation on the floor, report-out, and 30/60/90-day follow-up.
* Help sites build and manage their CI pipeline so events are selected based on business priorities, KPI gaps, and financial impact.
* Develop site Kaizen leaders and facilitators so sites can run events on their own and meet their annual Kaizen plan.
* Document event results and savings, and partner with site finance to validate benefits.

***Coaching and Capability Building***

* Deliver EOS training on site, from leadership sessions to hands-on floor training for supervisors and team members.
* Coach site leaders, supervisors, and EOS Managers on daily management, visual management, standard work, and problem solving.
* Support site EOS Managers in developing EOS champions and practitioners at their sites.

***Assessment, Tracking, and Feedback***

* Support EOS maturity assessments and certification readiness reviews, including site tours, interviews, and evidence review.
* Monitor deployment progress, action closure, and sustainment at supported sites, and report status to the EOS Program Lead.
* Help site leaders remove barriers, and raise issues to the EOS Program Lead when deployment is at risk.
* Bring field feedback into the EOS program: what works, what does not, and where process guides, tools, and training need to change.
* Share good practices across sites and connect site teams with each other.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, Supply Chain, or related field required.
* 8+ years of experience in operational excellence, continuous improvement, Lean, or manufacturing operations, including at least 5 years in a hands-on deployment or practitioner role.
* Has personally facilitated 10 - 20 or more Kaizen events with documented results.
* Hands-on experience practicing and coaching tiered daily management (MDI or similar), Gemba Walks, visual management, standard work, and structured problem solving (A3, PDCA, root cause analysis).
* Experience in a company with a structured operating or business system strongly preferred. Must be a U.S. Person and able to provide appropriate documentation
* Experience supporting deployment across multiple sites preferred.
* Plant or operations leadership experience preferred. Credibility with site leaders and on the floor is essential.
* Aerospace, defense, industrial, or complex high-mix manufacturing experience preferred.
* Lean, Kaizen, or Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Must be a U.S. Person with a valid US passport with the ability to travel internationally.

**Required Capabilities**

* Practitioner first: comfortable on the shop floor and leading teams through hands-on change.
* Strong event facilitation, with the ability to lead mixed teams from operators to executives.
* Direct, constructive coaching of leaders at all levels, including senior leaders.
* Business acumen: connects improvement work to KPIs, EBIT, and customer commitments.
* Ability to adapt to sites at different maturity levels without lowering the standard.
* Ability to influence without direct authority.
* Self-directed and organized; manages a multi-site schedule with limited supervision.
* High accountability for follow-through and sustainment.

**Travel**

Expected travel of approximately **60% to 80%**, primarily domestic, with some international travel to sites in Mexico and the UK. A typical site visit runs 3 to 5 days, such as a Kaizen event week or a site support visit covering MDI, Gemba Walks, and other EOS activities. Candidates should be based near a major airport.

**Compensation Information** 
Base Salary Range: $190,000 - $220,000 USD (Annually)

**Actual base salary offered to the hired applicant will be determined based on their work location, level, qualifications, job related skills, as well as relevant education or training experience.**

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_roles.title: Director, Co-Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

The Director, Co-Manufacturing is responsible for developing, managing, and optimizing Mama's Creations' external manufacturing network to support the company's growth strategy, customer commitments, and operational objectives. This position serves as the enterprise leader for all co-manufacturing relationships, ensuring external partners consistently deliver exceptional service, Grandma Quality, food safety compliance, cost performance, and capacity support.

The Director will build strategic partnerships with contract manufacturers, lead commercialization and capacity expansion initiatives, and ensure co-manufacturing operations align with Mama's values of Commit to Craftsmanship, Nurture Relationships, Honor Heritage, and deliver Grandma Quality.

This role requires a highly collaborative leader who can influence cross-functional partners across Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, FSQA, R&D, Finance, Sales, and Customer Service while holding external manufacturing partners accountable for operational excellence and business results.

Position can be based in East Rutherford, NJ or Farmingdale, NY

**Co-Manufacturer Strategy & Relationship Management**

* Develop and execute the company's co-manufacturing strategy to support growth, innovation, customer requirements, and capacity needs.
* Identify, evaluate, qualify, negotiate, and onboard new co-manufacturing partners.
* Establish and maintain executive-level relationships with co-manufacturer leadership teams.
* Lead business reviews with co-manufacturing partners, focusing on performance, service, quality, cost, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure clear accountability, governance, and communication structures exist across all manufacturing partners.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for critical business, operational, quality, and supply issues.
* Relationship management and development of multi-site 3PL solution network.

**Operational Performance**

* Own service, inventory, capacity, quality, and cost performance across the co-manufacturing network.
* Establish performance metrics and scorecards to monitor supplier execution and compliance.
* Drive improvements in on-time delivery, schedule adherence, yield, waste reduction, and production efficiency.
* Partner with Supply Planning and Operations teams to align manufacturing capacity with demand forecasts and growth plans.
* Ensure co-manufacturers maintain appropriate labor, equipment, and material resources to support business requirements.

**Commercialization & Product Launches**

* Lead co-manufacturer activities associated with new product commercialization and customer-specific initiatives.
* Partner with Culinary Innovation, R&D, Operations, and FSQA teams to ensure successful product transfers and launches.
* Coordinate production trials, scale-up activities, process validations, and first-production runs.
* Ensure accurate production documentation, specifications, and operational readiness prior to launch.

**Quality, Food Safety & Compliance**

* Partner closely with FSQA to ensure all co-manufacturers consistently meet Mama's food safety, quality, regulatory, and customer requirements.
* Support supplier qualification, audit programs, CAPA activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with FDA, USDA, FSMA, HACCP, GMP, SQF, BRC, and customer-specific standards.
* Lead cross-functional response efforts related to quality events, recalls, customer complaints, or regulatory concerns.

**Financial Management**

* Own co-manufacturing budgets and financial performance.
* Collaborate with Procurement and Finance to negotiate manufacturing agreements and cost structures.
* Identify and execute productivity initiatives that improve margins while maintaining product quality and customer service.
* Evaluate capital and investment opportunities within the co-manufacturing network to support long-term growth.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and implement operational excellence initiatives across manufacturing partners.
* Leverage KPIs, root-cause analysis, and performance reviews to drive sustainable improvement.
* Promote Lean Manufacturing, waste reduction, and process optimization opportunities throughout the network.
* Share best practices among co-manufacturing partners to elevate overall network performance.

**Leadership & Talent Development**

* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, trust, and continuous improvement.
* Build strong cross-functional partnerships that support enterprise business objectives.
* Serve as a strategic thought partner to Operations leadership regarding network optimization and growth strategies

**Success Metrics**

* The Director, Co-Manufacturing will be measured on:
* Customer service levels
* OTIF (On-Time In-Full) performance
* Product quality performance
* Food safety compliance
* Network capacity utilization
* Manufacturing cost improvement
* Productivity savings
* Commercialization success rate
* Supplier scorecard performance
* Inventory performance
* Customer complaint trends
* EBITDA contribution from network optimization initiatives

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or related field.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing, supply chain, operations, or co-manufacturing leadership experience.
* Minimum 5 years managing contract manufacturers or external manufacturing networks.
* Experience within food manufacturing, refrigerated foods, CPG, or consumer packaged goods.
* Strong knowledge of FDA, USDA, FSMA, HACCP, GMP, SQF, and food manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets, cost optimization, and productivity initiatives.
* Exceptional negotiation, relationship management, and influencing skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience in refrigerated, deli-prepared foods, protein, or fresh food manufacturing.
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement certification.
* Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, or manufacturing network integrations.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Essential Physical Requirements**

* Ability to travel up to 50% of the time to manufacturing partners and company facilities.
* Ability to work within food manufacturing environments, including refrigerated production areas.
* Ability to wear required PPE while conducting plant visits and audits.
* Ability to stand and walk production facilities for extended periods.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**TBK One** began as an environmental consulting firm, helping businesses meet environmental standards through expert guidance, compliance support, and team education. As demand grew across industries such as oil drilling, refining, and concrete manufacturing, the company developed and manufactured its own eco-friendly industrial cleaning solutions to protect both equipment and the environment. Leveraging its expertise in environmental science, manufacturing, packaging, warehousing, and distribution, TBK One expanded its capabilities to support the broader operational needs of other businesses. Today, TBK One is a full-service partner for small and medium-sized businesses, delivering integrated, sustainable solutions backed by more than 20 years of environmental expertise.

**OUR VISION:** To be the premier provider of sustainable and innovative chemical solutions, transforming the way industries blend, package, and distribute their products.

**OUR MISSION:** To provide exceptional chemical blending and distribution services, ensuring quality, sustainability, and customer satisfaction at every step.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The Director of Operations is a senior leadership role responsible for day-to-day execution across blending, manufacturing, packaging, quality, warehousing, and distribution. Reporting directly to the CEO/Owner, this position serves as the primary point of operational accountability, translating company priorities into clear plans, scorecards, and measurable results while developing the operations team and organizational structure to support continued growth.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Operational Leadership & Strategy**

* Own end-to-end accountability for TBK One's daily operations, including blending, manufacturing, packaging, quality control, warehousing, and distribution.
* Translate enterprise and department-level priorities into clear operational plans, scorecards, and accountability for the operations team.
* Build and evolve the operations team structure to support growth and ensure the right people are in the right seats.
* Serve as the senior operational decisionmaker for production scheduling, capacity planning, and resource allocation.
* Report to the CEO/Owner on operational performance, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.

**Manufacturing, Production & Capacity**

* Oversee custom chemical blending, product formulation, reformulation, and full-service manufacturing operations.
* Partner with operational staff to measure plant capacity, throughput, and efficiency and close performance gaps as volume grows.
* Coordinate with Sales to establish realistic production expectations and timelines based on client needs, capacity, and operational requirements.
* Ensure equipment, staffing, and scheduling are aligned to meet customer commitments and seasonal demand.
* Provide operational input on pricing strategies, lead times, and cost estimates for custom blending and packaging products, as needed.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce waste, downtime, and production costs without compromising quality.

**Quality, Compliance & Safety**

* Maintain rigorous quality control standards across raw material inspection, in-process testing, and finished goods.
* Partner with the EHS (Environmental, Health and Safety) Advisor and Accounting/Finance leadership on environmental and regulatory requirements affecting operations, including chemical storage and EPA reporting.
* Champion SOP adherence and documentation across operational areas to support consistent process execution.
* Build and reinforce a strong safety-first culture throughout the warehouse and production floor.

**Warehousing, Distribution & Inventory**

* Oversee warehousing operations, inventory accuracy, and outbound distribution to support on-time, complete fulfillment.
* Optimize logistics and distribution workflows, leveraging TBK One's DFW location and highway access.
* Implement and monitor systems for real-time inventory visibility, cycle counts, and demand forecasting to minimize production interruptions.

**People Leadership & Organizational Systems**

* Lead, manage, and develop operations personnel and managers, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and development priorities as the organization grows.
* Run effective team meetings within the EOS framework, including Level 10 meetings, and maintain department-level scorecards and accountabilities.
* Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, training, and development for operations roles.
* Partner with the CEO/Owner on organizational design and succession planning as the operations function scales.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in operations management, engineering, chemistry, supply chain, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of progressive operations leadership experience, ideally in chemical manufacturing, industrial blending, or process manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing manufacturing, warehousing, and distribution functions simultaneously.
* Working knowledge of chemical safety, EPA/OSHA compliance, and quality control practices; DOT experience is a plus.
* Proven ability to build, manage, and develop teams, including managers or supervisors.
* Ability to operate with significant autonomy while maintaining strong alignment and communication with ownership/CEO.
* Experience with EOS or a similar operating system, including Rocks, scorecards, and Level 10 meetings, is strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of production and inventory planning systems is a plus.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and leadership skills.

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements**

This position works in both an office setting and production/warehouse environments, with frequent presence required in manufacturing and warehousing areas. Exposure to industrial chemicals, equipment, and noise is expected. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) will be provided and must be worn in accordance with applicable safety protocols. The position requires the ability to walk, stand, and move throughout warehouse and production environments for extended periods.

Join us as we lead the way in environmental innovation! This role offers an exciting chance to influence industry standards while working in a vibrant environment that values leadership, collaboration, and forward-thinking solutions.

Pay: $120,000.00 - $130,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

new_roles.title: Bottling Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Job Summary**

Lead bottling plant operations from production planning through finished-product quality. You’ll coordinate people, equipment, and supply chain activity to keep production organized, safe, and responsive to changing priorities. Use production data and systems to identify issues, guide decisions, and strengthen day-to-day performance.

**Responsibilities**

* Direct production management, scheduling, and planning for bottling and assembly operations; align staffing, materials, and equipment with production needs.
* Your impact: By coordinating production and quality control, you help teams deliver consistent products and keep supply moving to customers.
* Lead plant teams, set clear priorities, and communicate across manufacturing, quality, maintenance, and supply chain functions.
* Monitor production management systems and enterprise resource planning (ERP) tools, including SAP; use material requirements planning (MRP) and supply chain analytics to support decisions.
* Analyze data in Microsoft Excel, track operational performance, and lead continuous improvement using Lean manufacturing, Lean management, and Six Sigma methods.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in plant management, manufacturing management, production management, or operations management in a manufacturing environment.
* Knowledge of production scheduling, production planning, supply chain management, and ERP systems; SAP experience is relevant.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Excel data analysis; ability to interpret production and supply chain information.
* Demonstrated team leadership and cross-functional communication skills, with a practical approach to process improvement and continuous improvement.
* Mechanical knowledge and familiarity with quality control, Lean practices, and assembly operations are valuable.

Pay: $31,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Employee discount
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

new_roles.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Americas Operations Manager

\_\_

**Your role and responsibilities:** 
 
As the Plant Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of multiple US Manufacturing sites, specifically, the Modernization and Parts business unit within the Electrification Service Division in Florence, SC. This role includes production, engineering, procurement, quality, continuous improvement and logistics, in multiple locations. 
 
This is an on-site position based in Florence, SC. 
 
This role is contributing to the **Electrical Service Division** in **the Americas Region.** 
 
**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* **Drive manufacturing strategy** by implementing global/local plans, improving technology and capabilities, and executing continuous improvement to boost profitability, quality, and operational effectiveness.
* **Lead multi‑site operations** to achieve targets for revenue, EBITA%, cash flow, OTD, productivity, cost optimization, and customer satisfaction while ensuring strong sourcing, logistics, and supplier performance.
* **Champion safety, compliance, and standards** by embedding HSE, integrity, and quality requirements across all sites and ensuring adherence to global/local policies, tools, and processes.
* **Build and develop high‑performing teams** through effective organizational design, talent development, leadership appointments, and participation in strategic planning, budgeting, and long‑term capability building.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or business administration or technical field, advanced degree desirable, with 15+ years of experience in operations, with experience in manufacturing and multiply lines in production.
* Experience in service business, specific knowledge of Electrification business and products.
* Prior experience with high mix, low volume product lines in a manufacturing environment.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Demonstrated leadership capability with a history of change management.
* Ability to travel to multiple sites around 25% of the time, or as needed.

**More about us:**

ABB's Service Division partners with our customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The Division’s extensive service portfolio offers product care, modernization, and advisory services to improve performance, extend equipment lifetime and deliver new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, extracting the maximum value from them, and then recovering and regenerating products and materials at the end of their useful life.

**What's in it for you:**

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

**Other Forms of Compensation:** Potential End of Year Bonus

**Pay Grade:** 18

**Crothall Healthcare**, a Compass Healthcare company, provides specialized, high-quality, innovative, and responsive support services exclusively to the healthcare industry. Crothall serves many of the Top 100 Hospitals throughout its over 900 hospital partners across 46 states. Crothall has been recognized as one of Modern Healthcare’s Best Places to Work and Best Places to Work in Pennsylvania since 2013. Crothall has more than 32,000 team members, with core services include: Environmental Services, Patient Transportation, Patient Observation, Healthcare Facilities Management, Sterile Processing Services, and Ambulatory EVS. Learn more at www.Crothall.com.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Working as a **Regional Director of Operations (RDO)** you will lead, manage, and inspire a team of District Managers and other leaders in your region. You will be part of the regional leadership team and provide planning, direction, and guidance to the accounts in your territory, while establishing and maintaining strong client relationships. Your goal is to achieve operational and financial goals in a dynamic environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Leads, manages, and inspires a diverse team of District Managers, Resident District Managers, and/or Director of Dining Services, and their teams, to provide top-notch service
* Drives self and team towards building strong relationships with clients at all levels and achievement of KPIs (profitability, safety, engagement, etc.)
* Serves on regional leadership team; regularly communicates with peers to share best practices, mitigate risks, champion diversity, and build community
* Owns all accounts within assigned territory, ensuring input from and thoughtful communication with key partners; makes decisions grounded in balance of risk/reward and short/long term implications
* Supports RVP in setting cultural tone in region; meets regularly with extended team to ensure transparency, understanding, safety, accountability, and alignment
* Serves as representative/brand ambassador of the Chartwells team to senior clients in territory, and acts as escalation point
* Works with regional team members to ensure Sales and Retention process is smooth for all accounts (presentations, negotiations, etc.)
* Collaborates with key partners to support regional initiatives
* Ensures compliance with QA, policy, and USDA program requirements, along with completing all reporting on time
* Champions development in partnership with RVP within the region; conducts performance evaluations, along with succession planning, with focus on building multi-unit management skills; has full understanding of all roles in operation
* Owns the financial results/P&L for assigned territory, and works with leadership team to ensure accuracy for reporting, forecasting, and budgeting processes
* Ensures consistent and fair administration of all policies and procedures
* Recognizes and anticipates marketplace trends; participates in regional strategic planning meetings

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree from an accredited college or university, or eight (8) years progressive experience in multi-unit foodservice, hospitality management, plant operations management, environmental services, laundry distribution or other Support Services areas in lieu of degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong background in senior leadership roles with exposure to contract/budget management, customer service, people development, food services, negotiations, etc.
* Has a proven track record of growing a business and leading teams, along with strong financial acumen
* Has ability to think quickly, analytically, strategically, and accurately
* Shows expert client relationship, influencing, listening, and communications (written and verbal) skills
* Champions the inclusion mindset, and is proactive, positive, professional, flexible, and resilient
* Demonstrates initiative, ownership, multi-tasking, prioritization, and organization skills
* Proficient in the use of Microsoft Suite

Extensive travel required in this position

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**SUMMARY:** Directs production, distribution, maintenance, receiving, and supervision operations for the Plant, by performing the following duties personally or through subordinate supervisors.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Leads all departments in the plant with department supervisors (or production manager) to maintain safety, quality, and efficient production.
* Coordinates production, distribution, and warehousing in accordance with policies, principles, and established procedures.
* Develops and implements plans for efficient use of materials, machines, and employees.
* Reviews production costs and product quality and modifies production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of plant.
* Directs preparation of production, human resources, and labor/costs records.
* Recommends budgets to management. Assists management in negotiation of employee contracts.
* Maintains positive working relationship with sales management and customer service management.
* Systematically reviews financial performance of the plant to recommend to management opportunities for sales growth and cost savings.
* Coordinates plant safety, environmental and training activities in cooperation with the Human Resources Department.
* Comply with company policies and procedures.
* Additional duties as assigned by management.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manages subordinate supervisors and/or production manager who supervise all plant employees. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of these units.
* Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
* Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**:

* High school diploma or GED plus college and/or appropriate technical courses.
* Five years experience as a proven manager
* Ten years corrugated manufacturing experience
* Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:
* College degree

**LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
* Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:**

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
* Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**REASONING ABILITY:**

* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS:**

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

* Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation. This also supports the supervisor's role of teacher and trainer for his/her personnel.
* Cost issues in order to make daily decisions that will reduce overall costs and will help the supervisor find areas that require improvement.
* Budget development, adherence and analysis.
* Quality standards.
* Regulatory requirements including but not limited to wage and hour requirements, environmental and waste minimization, company policies, and personnel requirements including OSHA, DEQ and EEO.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**:

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, and sit.
* The employee is occasionally required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts.
* The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions.
* The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration.
* The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

**LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES**:

The individual must posses the following:

* Superior time management skills including the ability to manage multiple issues concurrently and the ability to lead an effective and efficient meeting.
* Teaching skills in order to function effectively as a teacher for his personnel both in the technical and administrative parts of the position.
* Excellent crisis manager who demonstrates that he/she has a high emotional control under adverse conditions and can lead his/her personnel to a successful resolution.
* Excellent employee relations skills including being an active listener, understanding how to appraise personnel, applying both positive and corrective feedback, being able to resolve conflicts either involving the supervisor directly or as a third party, understands and demonstrates positive motivational skills including coaching and delegation techniques.
* Demonstrated confidence including providing a consistent leadership style with an acceptable level of professional assertiveness.
* Professional appearance to support his/her role as a managerial representative of the company.

**PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS**:

The performance of the supervisor will be measured as follows:

* **Operating standards** - the Plant Manager will need to see that all reporting staff meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the supervisor.
* **Personal growth** - while the company will provide the tools to assist the supervisor to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the supervisor and his/her superior.

**Employee relations** - through observations the Plant Manager will be evaluated regarding his/her and his/her reporting staff's skills and advancements in the areas of motivational techniques and results, positive and corrective/constructive feedback, subordinate development and creating a positive work environment.

**Carolina Container Company is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.**

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
CAMS is looking for a Plant Manager at the Kings Mountain Energy Center in Kings Mountain, NC. The incumbent will have 19 direct and indirect employees. The Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable, compliant, and financially responsible operation and maintenance of the Kings Mountain Energy Center.

Kings Mountain Energy Center is a 475MW natural gas-fired combined-cycle power plant. The facility features an advanced 276MW Mitsubishi M501GAC gas turbine, a Vogt Power heat recovery steam generator (HRSG), a 225MW Toshiba steam turbine generator, and a Thermal Engineering International surface condenser.

The position provides overall leadership for plant operations, maintenance, engineering support, environmental and regulatory compliance, administration, workforce development, budgeting, outage execution, and continuous improvement. The Plant Manager serves as the primary site representative to CAMS leadership, facility ownership and asset management, and is accountable for developing a high-performing organization that maximizes plant availability, reliability, efficiency, and long-term asset value. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, sound technical and business judgment, and the ability to manage a complex combined-cycle generating facility in a competitive power-market environment.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for the safe, reliable, environmentally compliant, and cost-effective operation and maintenance of the facility.
* Establish and maintain a strong safety culture in which employees and contractors actively identify hazards, stop unsafe work, and demonstrate personal ownership of safety performance.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local environmental permits, laws, regulations, NERC requirements, OSHA requirements, company policies, and facility procedures.
* Lead and develop the plant management team and workforce, including recruiting, coaching, performance management, succession planning, qualification programs, and workforce development.
* Maintain effective working relationships with facility ownership, Asset Management, CAMS leadership, regulatory agencies, the system operator, utilities, OEMs, contractors, and other key stakeholders.
* Develop and execute annual operating plans, O&M budgets, capital plans, forecasts, and long-term maintenance strategies consistent with owner objectives and contractual requirements.
* Monitor plant financial performance and control expenditures while ensuring that short-term budget objectives do not create unacceptable safety, environmental, reliability, or long-term asset risk.
* Direct plant operations to achieve availability, reliability, heat-rate, start-reliability, capacity, and other performance objectives while meeting dispatch and commercial obligations.
* Provide leadership for maintenance strategies, preventive and predictive maintenance, corrective-maintenance backlog management, equipment reliability, root-cause analysis, and elimination of recurring failures.
* Direct planning and execution of combustion turbine, steam turbine, HRSG, generator, electrical, and balance-of-plant outages and major maintenance activities, including scope, budget, schedule, contractor performance, quality, and risk management.
* Develop and maintain multi-year outage, major-maintenance, and capital improvement plans based on equipment condition, OEM recommendations, operating profile, commercial requirements, and risk.
* Identify significant plant risks and provide CAMS leadership and ownership with timely information, alternatives, consequences, and clear recommendations for decision-making.
* Ensure appropriate critical-spares strategy, inventory controls, long-lead component planning, and equipment-obsolescence management.
* Oversee plant engineering and technical support activities, including equipment modifications, controls and logic changes, performance monitoring, capital projects, and technical problem solving.
* Ensure plant procedures, drawings, technical documentation, training materials, emergency plans, and operating records are accurate and maintained.
* Oversee administration of applicable plant contracts and agreements and ensure operational compliance with owner requirements, O&M obligations, OEM/LTSA requirements, fuel and utility agreements, and other commercial commitments.
* Maintain effective communication with Asset Management and ownership, including prompt escalation of significant safety, environmental, operational, equipment, financial, contractual, or regulatory events.
* Lead emergency response and business-continuity activities and ensure the facility is prepared for severe weather, grid emergencies, fuel interruptions, cyber events, and major equipment failures.
* Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement, and open communication across Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Compliance, and Administration.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve plant performance, reduce operating risk, optimize costs, and increase long-term asset value.
* Support CAMS fleet initiatives, peer reviews, lessons learned, workforce-development efforts, and cross-facility technical support as requested.

Other duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications and Skills**

* 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in power generation operations and maintenance, including significant leadership experience in a power plant environment.
* Prior Plant Manager, Operations Manager, Maintenance Manager, or comparable senior power-generation leadership experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge of combined-cycle power plant operations, maintenance, reliability, and major equipment systems. Experience with combustion turbines, steam turbines, HRSGs, generators, electrical systems, and balance-of-plant equipment is preferred.
* Experience with Mitsubishi M501GAC combustion turbines is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing major outages, managing contractors and OEMs, controlling outage scope and cost, and resolving emergent technical issues.
* Working knowledge of environmental, health and safety, and electric-generation regulatory requirements applicable to power plant operations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and managing O&M budgets, forecasts, capital projects, and long-term maintenance plans.
* Proven ability to lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable a multidisciplinary workforce.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, planning, and organizational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with employees, executives, owners, regulators, contractors, and technical personnel.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred. Significant relevant power-generation leadership experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and familiarity with computerized maintenance management systems, plant historians, performance-monitoring systems, and other power-plant business systems.
* Ability to respond to plant emergencies and significant operating events outside normal business hours as required.

Other Desirable Skills

* Demonstrates visible leadership and a strong personal commitment to safety and environmental compliance.
* Balances technical, operational, financial, and commercial considerations when making decisions.
