new_roles.description:
Description:

**Summary:** Responsible for general supervision of all phases of plant operations including production, quality control, high quality customer service, maintenance, receiving, and shipping. To assure that the plant is run in a safe, efficient, and proper manner. Manages subordinate staff in the day-to-day performance of their jobs.

**Essential Job Duties**

* Oversee all departments for the specific facility pertaining to production, administration, distribution, and safety.
* Develop relationships with and provide service to existing customers in efforts to promote customer retention and loyalty.
* Interact with customers to determine better service needs and implement changes accordingly.
* Manage key performance indicators relative to sales growth, collections, productivity, inventory control and profit margins.
* Establish accurate budget projections and work within the designated budget.
* Oversee product quality control and implement efficient changes as necessary.
* Manage aspects of human resources for all departments by hiring, terminating, and reassigning personnel to appropriate tasks as required.
* Assume other duties as assigned.
* Identify deficiencies and implement a plan for continuous improvement
* Actively reaching out and being involved in the local community.
* Ability to develop leadership at the lead person and foreman levels.
* Assume other duties as assigned.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Manage the work of others, including planning, assigning, scheduling and reviewing work, ensuring quality standards.
* Responsible for hiring, terminating, training and developing, reviewing performance and administering corrective action for staff.

Requirements:

**Minimum Requirements**

**Education & Experience**

* High School Diploma/GED.
* 5+ years of managerial/supervisory experience related to production, operations, and/or distribution.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Prior experience management in salvage yards.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**

* Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rates, ratios, and percentages and to draw and interpret graphs.
* Frequent use of Outlook, Word, Excel, graphics, etc. Ability to create, maintain and incorporate functions into Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, databases, and PowerPoint presentations to support business objectives.
* Frequently communicates complex information across departments and interacts with management. Can present, resolve and address delicate situations. Can motivate and persuade others.
* Problems are varied and complex, requiring analysis or interpretation of the situation. Problems are solved using knowledge and skills, general precedents and practices.
* Decisions impact the management and operations within a department or business unit. May contribute to business and operational decisions that affect the department.
* Provides and sets goals and priorities for functional areas. May make recommendations for department policies, practices, and programs. Makes decisions for and/or resolves problems for others.
* Handle multiple tasks or projects simultaneously with moderate complexity.

**Essential Physical Demands/Work Environment**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, reach, climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or sit for extended periods.
* The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds. On occasions, an employee may be asked to lift and/or move up to 100 pounds.
* The employee may be exposed to hazardous situations, conditions, and equipment. Must be able to work in cramped spaces or underneath vehicles that may require getting into awkward positions. May regularly wear personal protective equipment (PPE). May be exposed to extreme temperatures and high noise levels.
* Travel may be required periodically, including overnight stays (contingent on position requirements).

Notice Regarding the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Application Review

**Notice of AI Use in Job Application Review**

As part of our commitment in creating a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process we may use artificial intelligence (AI) to help our recruiting teams organize, summarize, and analyze information provided by candidates, including resumes, application responses, and other materials submitted during the application process.AI may be used to identify patterns, highlight relevant skills, and experience, and assist in comparing a candidate’s qualifications with the requirement of a specific role. These tools are to improve efficiency and consistency while supporting more informed hiring decisions, which will ultimately be made by the hiring team.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager - Little Chute
new_roles.description:
Description:

**POSITION SUMMARY & KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:**

The Plant Manager is responsible for leading all operational and financial activities and directly interacting and collaborating with all internal/external stakeholders and support departments. The Plant Manager will develop and execute long and short-term initiatives aligned to our broader business goals as an innovative label solutions partner.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ensure compliance and engagement with all Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) policies and procedures.
* Drive site performance by monitoring and managing key business metrics, including Safety, Quality, Delivery, Productivity, Cost, Inventory, and Employee Engagement.
* Actively lead in EHS, training, safety observations, hazard identification, and safety committees
* Foster, develop, and implement Continuous Improvement (CI) activities through all facets of the business
* Full Profit & Loss (P&L) statement responsibility
* Strategic planning including capital investments, budgets, staffing, and capacity. Additional support to Sales, Estimating, and R&D on strategic planning
* Lead daily production activities by monitoring performance against targets and provide support in attaining levels of expected performance
* Lead and develop leaders to achieve established goals of safety, quality, service, production, and cost
* Ensure the plant has the necessary tools and training to successfully and efficiently meet their goals
* Provide direction and guidance to the team through coaching and counseling; motivate, empower, develop and recognize individual and team achievements
* Develop & implement best in class training programs
* Support development and roll out of Standard Work including Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Work Instructions (WI), One Point Lessons, (OPL) and Training Documentation
* Works closely with Planning, Quality, HR, Logistics, Engineering, Maintenance, and EHS to ensure proper production planning and utilization of resources on the right priorities to meet customer requirements
* Reviews daily production schedule to plan work and coworker’s assignments. Rebalance based on utilization of assets and resources.
* Provides proactive leadership, actions, and results on safety, quality, and CI topics
* Develop and implement workflow practices & policies that enhance speed and efficiency without compromising safety or product quality
* Lead the CI process utilizing operational tool sets (i.e Lean, Six Sigma, 6S, TPS, TPM.) to provide high levels of performance
* Lead coworkers in performing operations according to sound operating principles and company policies and procedures
* Provides support regarding the manufacturing process and makes recommendations regarding safety, quality, tools, equipment, costs/expenses
* Analyzes, supports, and presents results on operational and financial business goals and outcomes
* Recruit, hire, train, motivate, and develop coworkers in line with our core values and company policies and practices.
* Support our commercial teams on customer related matters
* Maintains a high standard of professional knowledge, ethics, and practices when dealing with customers, suppliers, peers, coworkers, and leadership
* Other duties as requested

Requirements:

**REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES:**

* Familiar with CI, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma and other current manufacturing concepts, practices, and procedures
* Effective verbal and written communication skills including ability to effectively train and develop others
* Ability to coordinate plant activities and create material, manufacturing and communication flow throughout the facility
* Must demonstrate excellent leadership, communication, and team building skills across direct reports as well as support departments
* Strong business acumen (leadership principles, strategic planning, critical thinking, budgeting, resource allocation, human resources, etc.)
* Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Experience with ERP systems

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, Operations or relevant experience
* 7-15 years manufacturing experience with at least 5 years of relevant experience

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to lift products up to 50 lbs.
* Ability to work in a standing position for long periods of time
* Other physical demands may include climbing, crouching, bending, reaching, stooping, etc.

**Reasonable Accommodations Statement**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Heartland Label Printers is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.**

**We participate in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the work eligibility of all new hires following an accepted job offer.**

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**For nearly 100 years, Everbrite** **has been providing innovative visual identification, outdoor signage, indoor signs & displays, menu systems, architectural & drive-thru elements, electronic displays, scoreboards, and LED lighting solutions to leading companies throughout the world.**

As an industry leader, our mission is to understand and exceed our customers’ needs. To that end we believe:

* Our employees are our greatest strength.
* Each product we develop and service is reflective of the great people we hire.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to a growing and dynamic work environment. If this is the environment for you, we would love to talk to you about a career with Everbrite.

**Position Summary:**

The Plant Manager will direct, manage, and coordinate all areas of production, materials, engineering, and related services through managers, supervisors and lead people to achieve timely production of quality products at the most economical cost and in the proper quantities, ensuring on-time delivery. Responsible for the operational improvements of all aspects of the plant production and process controls. Responsible for facility maintenance (building and grounds) and equipment, as well as supervising Environmental/Safety/Quality personnel. Organize and lead the Continuous Improvement Program to include cost savings projects and administration and documentation of the Idea program. Work with management in planning and implementing Quality/Continuous Improvement (QCI) activities.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Direct and manage all production-related departments (including maintenance and prototype) in general administration and enforcement of company rules and regulations. This includes employee selection and development, employee relations, discipline, safety, etc.
* Plan, organize and coordinate manufacturing procedures and operations to accomplish objectives in accordance with production and delivery schedules, skills and manufacturing capacities to maintain profitable operation.
* Provide technical expertise in terms of manufacturing, materials, lead-time, equipment workflow, resources to manufacture new products or improve manufacturing efficiency of existing products, while maintaining or improving quality.
* Control labor and material variances through adequate supervision and cost monitoring.
* Moderate production meetings to assist in planning and making recommendations on matters having to do with manufacturing operations.
* Manage finished goods inventory and warehouse facilities.
* Remain abreast of new manufacturing technology, equipment processes and management techniques through publications, seminars, workshops, or attending related shows or exhibits.
* Conduct timely performance reviews of direct reports, recommending training, changes of wage or status, updating or creating job descriptions, and setting agreeable goals and objectives.
* Maintain an efficient and skilled workforce through formal and informal training and work skill enhancement in order to meet projected workload, advancements in technology and compliance with Quality System requirements.
* Prepare reports and make presentations to members of plant, division and/or corporate management related to production performance.
* Ensure equipment receives regular preventative maintenance and that the plant’s housekeeping exceeds safety standards.
* Develop the most efficient way to employ manpower, machines, materials, information, and energy to manufacture the product or provide a service.
* Develop management control systems and processes to measure productivity, i.e., OEE (Overall Equipment Efficiency), OTD (On Time Delivery), etc.
* Analyze cycle times to improve/increase productivity. Design/improve production planning and control systems and resolve production process problems.
* Study material flow, operations sequence and recommend/implement appropriate changes.
* Evaluate the effects of product design changes.
* Design/improve manufacturing process methods to assure product quality. Assist in setting goals, and planning projects that will meet corporate and plant Quality/CI objectives.
* Oversee the administration of the Ideas program and cost savings projects.
* Assist management in maintaining the Plant within environmental and quality performance regulations.
* Key member of the Safety Committee.
* Assure all plant emergency systems are functioning properly.
* Responsible for developing, communicating, improving, and adhering to safety policies in all work environments and other areas.
* Participate in financial planning, cost/benefit analysis for building, grounds and plant equipment.
* Continue Quality/CI self-education training, Grand Kaizen and participating in other skill enhancement activities.
* Assure that plant personnel are trained and help develop their Quality/CI skills. Conduct Quality/CI skill enhancement sessions.
* Help develop Team Members’ skills; CI, problem solving, Quality, and provide leadership.
* Supervise maintenance department and plan work for maintenance employees, assuring Preventative Maintenance processes are followed. Assist and provide maintenance resources for CI/Kaizen projects.
* Work closely with equipment suppliers, plant staff, and Continuous Improvement Specialist to assure the successful operation of the plant.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Educational Requirements / Experience:**

* Business, manufacturing or engineering-related degree or equivalent years of related work experience. A formal apprenticeship or courses/seminars in supervision would be considered a plus.
* Minimum of 5 years of related production management experience from a similar type manufacturing company or 12 years of management experience from a non-related type of manufacturing.
* Minimum of 5 years’ continuous improvement experience with Lean Enterprise and/or Toyota Production System as demonstrated through participation in and leadership of CI events/projects.
* Possess Quality/CI program certification and/or demonstrate competency.

**Additional Attributes:**

* Excellent verbal communication skills, as well as the ability to utilize Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and E-mail to effectively communicate with others.
* Create presentations as necessary.
* Ability to work with a variety of individuals at all levels.
* Perform basic data analyses as required.
* Create charts, templates, flow maps for standards and clear communication of information.
* Self-motivated.
* Work independently and communicate effectively with others.
* Excellent Project Management skills.
* Lead and manage a team to bring closure to projects.
* Systematic and analytical approach to problem solving.
* Proficient with the concepts and tools of Quality Tools and Lean Manufacturing used in Kaizen analysis.
* Proficient with Value Stream Mapping tools.
* Apply Lean manufacturing tools and train plant associates on various lean tools and techniques, as well as become the resource “expert” for lean methodologies.
* Track and report plant improvement progress.
* Work with team members and supervisors to sustain results by monitoring 30, 60 and 90 day follow up reports.
* Strong leadership and organizational skills with aptitude for facilitating teams and/or activities. Effectively lead a team through an entire event – from training through report-out.
* Show initiative, desire to drive change and motivation to exceed expectations.
* Skilled in statistical knowledge and the ability to apply statistics to product and process improvement projects.
* Competent in Lean principles, including Waste elimination, Pull systems, Kanban, Visual workspace, One Piece Flow, Flow Production, Set-Up Reduction, Standardized Work, Variation Reduction, Error Proofing, Total Productive Maintenance, Ergonomics, Problem Solving, and Level Loading.

**Equal Opportunity Statement:** Everbrite, LLC provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking a team-oriented, hands-on Plant Manager with a robust background in maintenance leadership. This role is responsible for overseeing all aspects of plant operations, with a particular emphasis on developing and executing a world-class maintenance program at our mill in St. Maries, Idaho. The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence, safety, and continuous improvement, ensuring the facility meets production goals while maintaining the highest standards of equipment reliability and team development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the plant’s manufacturing and maintenance operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and reliable production.
* Oversee preventive, predictive, and proactive maintenance programs, including planning, scheduling, and execution.
* Direct and develop a multidisciplinary team, including Maintenance Planners, Millwrights, Electricians, Mechanics, and Production Supervisors.
* Foster a “Safety First” culture, ensuring compliance with all safety and environmental regulations and serving as a role model for safe industrial behavior.
* Collaborate with other departments (Finance, HR, Sales, Marketing, Resources) to align plant performance with company goals and market demands.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging best practices in manufacturing and maintenance to optimize resources and processes.
* Lead and support improvement projects, including research, cost analysis, financial justification, and project management from conception to completion.
* Manage key performance indicators for maintenance and production, such as safety compliance, PM completion, downtime, overtime, expense controls, and plant cleanliness.
* Develop and retain high-performing teams through effective communication, training, and empowerment.
* Build strong relationships across the organization, ensuring active communication and teamwork.
* Utilize modern maintenance management tools (e.g., CMMS, AutoCAD, MS Suite) and interpret technical documents (e.g., blueprints).

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in plant management or senior manufacturing leadership, with a strong track record in maintenance supervision and program development.
* Minimum of five years in maintenance leadership, with hands-on experience in preventive, predictive, and proactive maintenance.
* Strong technical skills in troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and strong understanding of PLC systems.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams in a continuous improvement environment.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Effective communicator, able to set clear expectations and drive accountability.
* Experience with process optimization.
* Business acumen to manage budgets, control costs, and justify investments.
* High school diploma required; college-level education in a related field preferred.

new_roles.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

The Director of Operations is responsible for the activities of manufacturing, purchasing, quality, planning (supply chain), and project management of the organization and aids in formulating and administering organization policies.

#LI-SL1

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

* Participating in formulating/administering company policies and developing long range goals/objectives.
* Directing/coordinating activities of the responsible departments on a day-to-day basis to ensure that daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual objectives are met.
* Ensuring internal auditing for compliance with the ISO standards applicable.
* Driving cost reduction (productivity) planning and execution in accordance with the financial plan.
* Providing authorization for funds to ensure responsible fiduciary spending in accordance with financial policies.
* Reviewing/analyzing activities related to costs, operations, CAPEX, and forecast data to determine progress toward financial goals and objectives and considering the long-range impact of growing the business and adjusting actions to ensure compliance.
* Overseeing the budget/forecast processes as well as ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance.
* Conferring with other senior personnel to review achievements and discuss required changes in goals or objectives resulting from current status/conditions.
* Developing plans and executing actions to meet the decision upon actions.
* Providing oversight and coordination to other business in Operations related matters to drive consistency among the businesses.
* Participating in due diligence process as requested.
* Developing succession planning strategies in coordination with HR to ensure continuation of leadership/individual contributor roles going forward.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management, Industrial Engineering, or related field
* Master’s Degree in Business Administration (required)
* 20+ years of relevant operations experience (required)
* 20+ years of experience as a Senior Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or a similar role, preferably in a heavy manufacturing environment with multi-site responsibility
* 10+ years of experience with TPM and SAP
* Welding, Fabricating, Warehouse & Logistics experience
* Operational Excellence or Lean Certification
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing
* Staff development and engagement skills
* Bi-lingual Spanish/English preferred

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

**Hubbell Utility Solutions**

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class.

The above summary of position responsibilities and requirements is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an exhaustive list of duties, skills, efforts, physical requirements, or working conditions associated with the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

new_roles.title: Director, Process Engineering - Head of Internal Operations
new_roles.description:
We’re here for one reason and one reason only – to cure cancer. Every moment is dedicated to developing treatments and every action moves us one step closer to our goal. We’ve made incredible scientific breakthroughs and our pioneering personalized CAR T-cell therapies have changed the paradigm. But we're not finished yet.

 

Join Kite, as we make even bigger advances in cancer therapies, and help shape where our business and medical science goes next.

 

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfill their aspirations. Join Kite and help create more tomorrows.

**Job Description**
-------------------

 

We will consider candidates in Foster City, El Segundo, Oceanside and Thousand Oaks, CA

 

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
========================

**Strategic and Functional Leadership**
---------------------------------------

* Set the Internal Operations strategy, priorities, governance, and resource plan in alignment with Network MSAT, Process Development and Manufacturing-site needs, and enterprise objective.

* Lead project leaders and technical SMEs by establishing clear accountabilities, decision rights, and escalation pathways.

* Build a capable, inclusive, and accountable team; develop successors and strengthen project leadership, process stewardship, and investigation capabilities.

* Serve as the primary connection between Network MSAT and manufacturing sites, translating site priorities and technical risks into network actions.

* Define and monitor practical measures for portfolio delivery, process-document maturity, investigation effectiveness, risk reduction, and realized business value.

* Advise the Head of Network MSAT and senior stakeholders on operational risk, organizational capability, deploy resources and investments, as required, to deliver near- and long-term objectives, in a scalable manner.

* Provide leadership during high-impact manufacturing events, risks, regulatory challenges, and technical investigations; with clear executive communication.

**Global Project and Portfolio Leadership**
-------------------------------------------

* Accountable for leading a focused portfolio of highly-complex, cross-site MSAT projects with clear outcomes, milestones, resources, risks, and governance.

* Partner with cGML and Process Design to reflect lessons learned and improvements made to our commercial operations, which has strengthened process robustness, operational readiness, and cost effectiveness.

* Integrate project execution with validation, regulatory, supply, and site implementation plans to support predictable delivery.

**Process Stewardship and Standardization**
-------------------------------------------

* Own the governance and lifecycle of standardized global process documentation, including enhanced Process Description Reports (ePDRs).

* Lead global MSAT impact assessments for change controls and lifecycle changes to maintain cross-site consistency and reduce process drift.

* Expand process stewardship to pFMEAs, control strategy linkages, reusable technical knowledge, and effective handoffs into routine operations.

**Global Investigations and Technical Problem Solving**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Lead complex cross-site investigations involving process performance, critical quality attributes, comparability, assay variability, and recurring manufacturing issues.

* Establish a consistent global investigation framework, including trigger and escalation criteria, a practical playbook, analytical tools, and lessons learned.

* Ensure investigation conclusions are scientifically sound and translated into sustainable process improvements or lifecycle actions.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
========================

* Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering, biochemical engineering, biotechnology, biochemistry, biology, chemistry, or a related scientific/engineering discipline with 12+ years of relevant experience; OR a Master's degree with 10+ years of relevant experience; OR a PhD with 8+ years of relevant experience.

* Significant people-leadership experience, including leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional programs across multiple sites or business units, including strategy, governance, prioritization, resource planning, risk management, and delivery through others.

* Demonstrated leadership of global or cross-site investigations involving process performance trends, critical quality attributes, comparability, assay or method variability, and product-impact assessment.

* Demonstrated experience supporting cGMP manufacturing, process lifecycle management, technical investigations, change impact assessment, CAPA, and inspection readiness.

* Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, apply systems thinking, influence senior stakeholders without direct authority, and translate technical risks into clear business decisions.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with senior leaders and represent the organization in high-stakes technical and operational forums.

* Strong relationship-building and influencing skills, with the ability to align senior stakeholders and lead effectively without direct authority.

* Clear, concise, and audience-appropriate communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical topics into business decisions.

* High learning agility, sound judgment, and comfort operating through ambiguity, changing priorities, and incomplete information.

* Demonstrated emotional intelligence, active listening, constructive challenge, and conflict-resolution skills.

* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance urgent operational needs and longer-term capability development.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
============================

* Direct experience across MSAT, Manufacturing, Quality, Lifecycle Management, Technology Transfer, and/or Process Development.

* Experience in cell therapy, gene therapy, viral vector, biologics, aseptic processing, or other complex biotechnology manufacturing platforms.

* Experience leading technology transfers, new product introductions, validation/PPQ, comparability, continued process verification, and post-approval lifecycle changes.

* Working knowledge of Lean, Operational Excellence, DMAIC, statistical process control, Quality by Design, FMEA, and structured root cause analysis.

* Experience using data, analytics, automation, or digital tools to improve portfolio decisions, technical investigations, process monitoring, and knowledge management.

* Proven success developing technical experts, establishing new organizational capabilities, and leading transformation while sustaining near-term business delivery.

The salary range for this position is:

Bay Area: $226,185.00 - $292,710.00. 
 
Other US Locations: $205,615.00 - $266,090.00. 

Kite considers a variety of factors when determining base compensation, including experience, qualifications, and geographic location. These considerations mean actual compensation will vary. This position may also be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, discretionary stock-based long-term incentives (eligibility may vary based on role), paid time off, and a benefits package. Kite is based in Santa Monica, CA. For more information on Kite, please visit www.kitepharma.com . Sign up to follow @KitePharma on Twitter at www.twitter.com/kitepharma .

new_roles.description:
**Who We Are**

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. For more information on our company please see our web site at www.sens-usa.com.

**Summary**

The Senior Manager, Warehouse Operations leads the people, processes, and systems that maintain accurate inventory and reliable material flow across Stored Energy Systems (SENS) manufacturing operations. Based at Disc Drive headquarters, this role leads teams and team members across all SENS locations on first shift (days) and second shift (evenings). The role oversees receiving, warehousing, inventory control, material handling, production replenishment, kitting, inter-factory transportation, shipping, and freight coordination, while developing teams and operating capacity to support production continuity, customer deliveries, and growth.

**Responsibilities**

Leadership and Operating Performance

* Establish consistent material handling and inventory management standards, performance expectations, and accountability across all locations.
* Develop supervisors and team leaders through coaching, training, performance management, and succession planning.
* Own Warehouse Operations staffing plans and coordinate coverage, priorities, and escalation processes across all locations and both shifts to support production needs.
* Promote safe material handling and consistent workplace practices in partnership with the Environmental Health and Safety team.

Inventory Accuracy and Control

* Own inventory accuracy and control standards across SENS inventory locations, including inventory held at partner locations.
* Establish consistent receiving, put-away, picking, transfer, issue, return, and reconciliation processes in Infor SyteLine. Oversee receipt processing for non-inventory purchases.
* Lead cycle counting, inventory discrepancy investigations, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Maintain material identification, traceability, first-in, first-out practices, and segregation of restricted or nonconforming inventory.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance on inventory reconciliation and actions to improve inventory health, supporting Procurement’s ownership of inventory turns, safety stock levels, and excess and obsolete inventory.
* Lead preparation and execution of annual physical inventories at all SENS locations.

Production Material Flow

* Lead production material delivery, including stock picking, replenishment of point-of-use inventory areas, scheduled material delivery routes, and kanban replenishment parameters. Align execution with sales, inventory, and operations planning (SIOP) and production schedules.
* Develop and implement scalable assembly-phase kitting processes for configure-to-order and engineer-to-order products. Ensure kit accuracy, completeness, alignment with current revisions, staging, and return of unused materials.
* Coordinate material priorities, shortage escalations, and decisions about incomplete kits with Planning, Production, and Procurement.
* Establish visual management and kanban replenishment processes from kitting through delivery to production lines.

Transportation, Shipping, and Freight

* Own inter-factory transportation and inventory transfers, movement of finished products to shipping, and return flows for empty bins, carts, and protective packing materials.
* Lead local shipping operations and centralized inbound and outbound freight execution, coordinating with Planning & Fulfillment and Order Management to support on-time, complete customer shipments.
* Manage freight and premium freight costs against budget and maintain transportation contingency plans to support production continuity and customer deliveries.

Capacity and Continuous Improvement

* Translate production forecasts into logistics capacity plans. Lead warehouse and material-flow readiness for factory expansions and production ramps, including space, staffing, and training.
* Improve productivity through standard work, waste reduction, daily performance management, process automation, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) system improvements, in partnership with IT, Manufacturing Engineering, and Continuous Improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in manufacturing inventory, warehousing, and logistics, including 5+ years leading supervisors and teams across multiple sites and shifts.
* Demonstrated success scaling warehouse operations in a high-growth manufacturing environment.
* Strong knowledge of inventory controls, ERP transactions, cycle counting, kanban, supermarkets, production replenishment, and order kitting.
* Experience managing shipping operations, transportation providers, and freight costs.
* Experience supporting repetitive manufacturing production.
* Demonstrated ability to improve inventory accuracy, establish consistent operating practices, and develop effective supervisors and team leaders.
* Ability to analyze operational and financial data, resolve problems, and communicate priorities and issues across functions.
* Experience implementing Lean or continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, operations, engineering, or a related field
* Relevant supply chain, logistics, or Lean certification.
* Experience with Infor SyteLine, barcode scanning, and warehouse management systems.
* Experience in electrical equipment, industrial products, or similarly complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting configure-to-order or engineer-to-order production.

**Location:** Longmont, CO

**Base Compensation:** $135,000 - $165,000 is the projected range of annual base salary for this role depending on the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience.

**Bonus:** This position is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance.

**Closing Date:** December 1st. While we expect to keep the position open through this date, the posting may be extended or closed early based on applicant volume and hiring needs.

**Onsite Perks**

* Free gym with 24/7 access
* Free Electric Vehicle charging
* Breakfast and Lunch Café
* After hours Grab & Go snacks
* Basketball court
* Walking paths

**Benefits**

* Paid Time Off
* Paid holidays
* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Life insurance
* 401(k) plan with immediate vesting
* Employee referral program

new_roles.title: SR. Manager Human Resources, Manufacturing (People & Culture)
new_roles.description:
**Job Description Summary:**

At The Coca-Cola Company, our people and culture are essential to how we create value, grow our business, and make a difference every day. We are looking for a **Senior Manager, Human Resources-People & Culture (Manufacturing)** who will bring strong business partnership, sound judgment, and hands-on People & Culture leadership to two manufacturing locations supporting both union and non-union associates.

 

This role is the Primary **People & Culture Leader and** visible face of **Human Resources at the plant** , serving as a trusted partner to plant leadership and an accessible resource for associates. The Senior Manager will report directly to the Plant Manager, with a dotted-line relationship to the Director, People & Culture, helping ensure strong alignment between plant priorities and broader People & Culture strategies, standards, and practices.

 

Success requires someone who can move comfortably between the plant floor and leadership discussions. You will listen to associates, coach leaders, navigate complex employee and labor relations matters, use workforce insights to inform decisions, develop talent, and translate business priorities into practical people solutions. The ideal candidate brings manufacturing Human Resources experience, labor relations capability, strong business acumen, a commitment to inclusion, and the ability to build credibility and trusted relationships at every level of the organization.

 

**Key Responsibilities and Position-Related Functions**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Serve as the senior on-site People & Culture partner for two manufacturing locations, providing hands-on leadership and support across union and non-union associate populations.
* Partner directly with the Plant Manager and plant leadership teams to translate operational and business priorities into actionable workforce, talent, culture, and organizational initiatives.
* Serve as the primary, visible People & Culture resource for associates, creating an approachable and trusted presence across shifts and levels of the organization.
* Coach and advise plant leaders on organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, performance management, accountability, employee development, workforce decisions, and people-related business challenges.
* Lead and support employee relations matters with objectivity, consistency, confidentiality, sound judgment, and appropriate partnership with the Director, People & Culture and other subject-matter experts.
* Support labor relations within the unionized location, including interpretation and consistent application of the collective bargaining agreement, issue resolution, grievance processes, and development of productive labor-management relationships.
* Partner with leaders to promote a positive, inclusive, safe, and respectful workplace where associates can contribute, grow, and thrive.
* Lead workforce planning discussions, using workforce data and operational insights to identify talent needs, retention risks, organizational opportunities, and appropriate actions.
* Strengthen leader capability in performance management, associate engagement, development conversations, conflict resolution, and consistent application of People & Culture practices.
* Partner with leaders on talent reviews, succession planning, career development, critical-role planning, and development opportunities that build plant capability.
* Support recruiting and selection activities in partnership with Talent Acquisition and plant leaders, including workforce requirements, candidate assessment, pre-employment activities, and an effective transition from candidate to associate.
* Lead and continuously improve new-hire onboarding and integration, helping new associates understand performance expectations, workplace culture, policies, resources, and ways of working.
* Provide guidance to associates and leaders on pay, benefits, leave, workplace policies, Human Resources programs, systems, and processes, engaging appropriate partners when specialized expertise is required.
* Analyze turnover, attendance, staffing, engagement, workforce demographics, and other people data to identify trends and translate insights into practical recommendations for plant leadership.
* Apply digital tools, automation, and artificial intelligence responsibly to improve People & Culture insights, efficiency, associate experience, and decision-making while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and data stewardship.
* Ensure People & Culture practices and documentation are consistent with company policies, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and employment and labor requirements.
* Maintain accurate and appropriate associate records, documentation, systems, and reporting, with a strong focus on data integrity and confidentiality.
* Partner closely with the Director, People & Culture, keeping them informed of material plant activities, emerging workforce risks, labor and employee relations matters, and issues requiring escalation or broader functional support.
* Lead or support People & Culture programs, change initiatives, communications, events, and projects that strengthen organizational effectiveness and the associate experience across both locations.
Build effective partnerships across the broader People & Culture network and plant functions to solve problems, implement change, and deliver sustainable business and people outcomes. 

 

**Education and Qualifications**
--------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial or Labor Relations, Organizational Development, or a related field.
* 7+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, with meaningful experience supporting manufacturing, supply chain, distribution, or another complex operational environment.
* Demonstrated experience supporting both **union and non-union employee populations** , including practical knowledge of labor relations, collective bargaining agreements, grievance management, and consistent contract administration.
* Experience serving as a trusted Human Resources partner to senior operational leaders and translating business priorities into effective people solutions.
* Strong employee relations capability, including experience evaluating complex workplace situations, conducting or supporting investigations, resolving conflict, managing risk, and determining when escalation or specialist partnership is appropriate.
* Strong working knowledge of employment practices, labor relations principles, performance management, leave practices, and Human Resources policy interpretation.
* Experience supporting hourly and salaried populations and building credibility with associates and leaders across multiple organizational levels and work schedules.
* Demonstrated capability in workforce planning, talent management, succession planning, associate engagement, organizational effectiveness, and leader development.
* Strong data literacy with the ability to interpret workforce metrics, identify meaningful trends, develop insights, and use evidence to influence business decisions.
* Digital fluency across Human Resources information systems and productivity platforms; experience with UKG/Kronos or comparable workforce management technology is preferred.
* Practical understanding of responsible artificial intelligence use and an ability to identify opportunities to apply digital and AI-enabled solutions to People & Culture work while protecting confidential associate information.
* Strong communication, coaching, influencing, facilitation, conflict-resolution, and relationship-building skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and make timely decisions in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Ability to lead through change, navigate ambiguity, and build alignment among stakeholders with different perspectives and priorities.
* Demonstrated commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace in which associates are treated with dignity and respect and have opportunities to contribute and develop.
* Ability to build productive partnerships across two locations while maintaining a strong, visible presence with plant leadership and associates.
Human Resources professional certification, such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR, is valued but not required. 

The Coca-Cola Company will not offer sponsorship for employment status (including, but not limited to, H1-B visa status and other employment-based nonimmigrant visas) for this position. Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require The Coca-Cola Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.

**Skills:**

Analytics Insights, Human Resources Policies, Human Resources Training, Leadership, Strategic Human Resources Leadership, Waterfall Model

**Pay Range:**

United States: 130,000 - 147,000 USD


*Base pay offered may vary depending on geography, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. A full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position, is offered.*

**Location(s):**

United States of America

**City/Cities:**

Ontario

**Travel Required:**

00% - 25%

**Relocation Provided:**

No

**Job Posting End Date:**

November 27, 2026

**Our Purpose and Growth Culture:**

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. When we collect your personal information as part of a job application or offer of employment, we do so in accordance with industry standards and best practices and in compliance with applicable privacy laws.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Production
new_roles.description:
**Career Area:**

Manufacturing

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Caterpillar is seeking a **Senior Manager Production** to provide senior leadership for production operations at our Griffin Engine Packaging Plant. This role serves as a key production leader responsible for overseeing genset and power module manufacturing operations in a fast-paced, high-velocity production environment.

As the leader of a team consisting of seven direct-report supervisors and multiple indirect reports, you will drive operational performance across safety, quality, productivity, and cost objectives while creating an environment focused on employee development and operational excellence.

This position offers the opportunity to lead large-scale power systems production operations, overseeing products ranging from approximately 400 kVA to 4 MW. The successful candidate will champion a safety-first culture, support lean manufacturing initiatives, and provide leadership for day-to-day operational execution and continuous improvement efforts.

### **How You Will Make an Impact**

* **Safety-Driven Culture** - Lead with a safety-first mindset and drive a culture where safety is the top operational priority.
* **Operational Excellence** - Deliver strong manufacturing performance through effective management of safety, quality, productivity, and cost objectives.
* **People Leadership and Development** - Develop, coach, and support leaders while building organizational capability across the production team.
* **Lean Manufacturing Leadership** - Champion lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance.
* **Large-Scale Power Systems Production** - Provide leadership for genset and power module production operations supporting a complex manufacturing environment.

Responsibilities include:

* Leading production operations within a high-velocity manufacturing environment.
* Driving safety performance and fostering a safety-first culture throughout the organization.
* Managing competing priorities related to safety, quality, productivity, and cost.
* Leading employee development activities and performance management processes.
* Resolving day-to-day operational escalations and manufacturing challenges.
* Supporting lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Overseeing genset and power module production operations.; emphasis on NPI operational support (i.e headcount, capacity planning, etc...)

### **Degree Requirement**

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.

### **What Skills You Will Have**

**Production Training:** Extensive knowledge of approaches, tools and techniques for delivering formal and informal training on the safe and efficient operation of production machinery; ability to conduct effective formal and situation-specific training.

**Problem Solving:** Extensive knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations

**Influencing:** Extensive knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization.

**Flexibility and Adaptability:** Extensive knowledge of successful approaches and techniques for dealing with change; ability to adapt to a changing environment and be comfortable with change.

**Performance Management:** Extensive knowledge of successful performance management techniques; ability to apply organization's performance management system, practices, and tools to developing and improving individual, team, and organizational performance.

**Analytical Thinking:** Extensive knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

**Planning and Organizing:** Extensive knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.

**Effective Communications:** Extensive understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

**Leadership & People Management:** Extensive understanding of the techniques and skills needed to lead in the production environment; with the demonstrated ability to develop talent using performance management techniques

### **Top Candidates Will Also Have**

* Experiences as a leader of leaders; specifically in cross-functional teams with support staff
* Manufacturing experience in the product producing environment; preference for heavy equipment, automotive, aerospace, rail, or other closely related industries.
* Examples of contributing to or leading manufacturing process transformation
* LEAN/Six Sigma Certification.

### **Additional Information**

* **Location:** Griffin, Georgia
* **Work Arrangement:** Onsite
* **Relocation:** Available
* **Travel:** Less than 10%
* **Sponsorship:** Not available

#LI

**Summary Pay Range:**

$147,760.00 - $221,640.00

Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar.

**Benefits:**

Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. This is a summary list of benefits.

* Medical, dental, and vision benefits\*
* Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holidays, Volunteer, etc.)\*
* 401(k) savings plans\*
* Health Savings Account (HSA)\*
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)\*
* Health Lifestyle Programs\*
* Employee Assistance Program\*
* Voluntary Benefits and Employee Discounts\*
* Career Development\*
* Incentive bonus\*
* Disability benefits
* Life Insurance
* Parental leave
* Adoption benefits
* Tuition Reimbursement

* These benefits also apply to part-time employees

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Relocation is available for this position.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

**Posting Dates:**

November 11, 2026 - November 18, 2026

Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen.

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Additive Manufacturing Operations
new_roles.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world's most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

**Purpose**
-----------

We are seeking an exceptional, results-driven **Senior Manager of Additive Manufacturing Operations** to lead and scale our Factory 1 production organization. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for driving world-class execution across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people development while shaping the future of manufacturing.

The Additive Manufacturing organization leverages proprietary, state-of-the-art systems and processes to execute metal laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), depowdering, manual and automated support removal, surface finishing, heat treatment, and inspection across multiple factory sites supporting both prototype and high-rate production.

This role is ideal for an ambitious operations leader who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments and combines strong manufacturing fundamentals with data-driven decision making, automation, and continuous improvement. Beyond delivering daily operational performance, this leader will develop people, build scalable operating systems, and partner with engineering to industrialize new technologies that will define the next generation of manufacturing.

The ideal candidate is energized by difficult manufacturing challenges, inspires high-performing teams, and is passionate about building organizations capable of delivering exceptional results.

**The Role**
------------

**Operational Leadership**

* Lead Factory 1 additive manufacturing operations to achieve world-class performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and equipment reliability.

* Build, develop, and mentor a high-performing team while fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement.

* Drive disciplined daily management through standard work, visual management, structured problem solving, and operational rigor.

* Optimize manufacturing flow by increasing equipment uptime, eliminating bottlenecks, improving process repeatability, and maximizing production throughput.

* Partner closely with Platform Development, Manufacturing Engineering, and Automation teams to successfully launch new equipment, technologies, and manufacturing capabilities.

**Operational Excellence**

* Champion Lean Manufacturing principles and continuous improvement across all additive manufacturing processes.

* Establish scalable operating systems that improve efficiency, stability, and manufacturing readiness as production grows.

* Utilize manufacturing data, KPIs, and analytics to drive operational decisions and prioritize improvement initiatives.

* Develop meaningful performance dashboards and operating rhythms that enable rapid identification and resolution of production issues.

* Lead initiatives to improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), first-pass yield, cycle time, labor productivity, and cost per part.

**Equipment Reliability & Technical Capability**

* Continue developing the in-house Additive Manufacturing Service organization by strengthening technical capability, preventive maintenance programs, troubleshooting processes, and technician training.

* Drive reliability initiatives that maximize printer availability, reduce unplanned downtime, and improve long-term equipment performance.

* Partner with technical teams to identify recurring equipment issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.

**Performance Monitoring & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), work instructions, process controls, and quality standards.

* Monitor key operational metrics and hold teams accountable for achieving business objectives.

* Drive disciplined root cause analysis and corrective actions to eliminate recurring manufacturing issues.

* Develop clear, actionable operational reporting that enables data-driven decision making across the organization.

**Safety, Quality & Financial Management**

* Foster a safety-first culture aligned with Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) standards and best practices.

* Partner with EHS to proactively develop and implement safety initiatives that reduce operational risk.

* Ensure manufacturing processes consistently meet internal quality requirements and applicable industry standards.

* Develop, manage, and execute the Factory 1 Additive Manufacturing operating budget while balancing productivity, cost, and long-term capability investments.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls.

* Demonstrated success leading complex manufacturing operations in high-performance production environments.

* Proven ability to build, develop, and lead high-performing technical organizations.

* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing, operational excellence, and continuous improvement methodologies.

* Experience using manufacturing data and operational metrics to drive strategic decision making and measurable business results.

* Proven ability to execute in startup or rapidly scaling manufacturing environments while effectively navigating ambiguity and change.

* Demonstrated success improving operational performance through equipment reliability, process optimization, and organizational development.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Weld Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Leadership experience in metal additive manufacturing or other advanced manufacturing environments.

* Experience with Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) production systems.

* Experience with aerospace manufacturing standards, including AS9100 and NADCAP.

* Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Theory of Constraints, or similar operational excellence methodologies.

* Experience leading automation, Industry 4.0, MES, or digital manufacturing initiatives.

* Demonstrated success scaling manufacturing organizations through periods of rapid growth.

**What We Offer Our Regular, Full-Time Employees:**

* **Holistic Compensation Package:** Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.
* **Wellness and Time Off:** Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.
* **Comprehensive Health and Wellness:** Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.
* **Investment in Growth:** We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.
* **Collaborative and High-Performing Environment:** Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, mission-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

 

***Equal Employment Opportunity*** 
*Divergent is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected characteristic. Divergent provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with Disabilities and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act.* 
*EEO Poster*

*In order to adjust to changes in our business, it may become necessary to add, remove or modify certain duties and responsibilities, or to reassign you to another job position. From time to time you may be asked to work on special projects or to assist with other work. Your cooperation and assistance in performing such additional work is expected.* 
 
***E-Verify: Right to Work*** 
*Our company participates in* *E-Verify**. E-Verify is a program that electronically confirms a candidate's eligibility to work in the United States after completing the Employment Eligibility Verification (Form I-9). The information provided on the Form I-9 is compared to the records contained in the Social Security Administration and Department of Homeland Security (DHS) databases. This helps employers verify the identity and employment eligibility of newly hired employees.* 
*Eligibility to Work Poster (English)* *|* *Eligibility to Work Poster (Spanish)* 
 
***Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance (FCIHO)*** 
*Pursuant to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance (FCIHO), we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

***No agencies, no solicitations, and no calls please.***

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality Engineering
new_roles.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

The Senior Manager, Quality Engineering is a senior leader responsible for leading complex, high-profile quality engineering initiatives across multiple applications, platforms, delivery teams, and implementation timelines, including solutions provided or supported by external vendors. This role provides program-level leadership, technical direction, coordination, and influence across cross-functional teams to ensure quality is built into every phase of the software delivery lifecycle.

The position develops and drives comprehensive quality strategies for strategic initiatives, including integrated test planning, risk-based testing, end-to-end validation, automation adoption, defect prevention, release readiness, and production quality. The role partners with Product, Engineering, Business Analysis, Architecture, Production Support, Delivery, business stakeholders, and vendor teams to align dependencies, resolve risks, and deliver measurable quality outcomes.

The role also supports the Aetna Medicare Technology Quality Engineering Program Management Office by helping manage the QE initiative portfolio, establishing consistent governance and reporting practices, monitoring milestones and dependencies, and providing leadership visibility into quality risks, delivery health, resource constraints, and release confidence.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead end-to-end quality engineering planning and execution for complex initiatives spanning multiple applications, platforms, releases, delivery teams, and vendors.
* Develop integrated, risk-based QE strategies covering scope, test levels, environments, data, automation, dependencies, quality gates, and release-readiness criteria.
* Coordinate functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, operational-readiness, and production-validation testing across internal and vendor teams.
* Maintain a holistic view of milestones, dependencies, risks, defects, resource constraints, vendor commitments, and delivery readiness; drive mitigation and escalation as needed.
* Establish quality expectations, deliverables, evidence requirements, acceptance criteria, and accountability measures for vendor partners and third-party solutions.
* Lead the AMT QE Program Management Office with initiative intake, prioritization, portfolio roadmaps, governance, dependency management, metrics, and executive reporting.
* Facilitate cross-functional governance, planning, status, defect, risk, and readiness forums to align stakeholders, resolve barriers, and drive timely decisions.
* Promote early quality engagement, root-cause analysis, defect prevention, and continuous improvement across the software delivery lifecycle.
* Advance test automation and AI-enabled QE capabilities to improve coverage, efficiency, maintainability, defect analysis, and quality insights.
* Define and communicate quality, vendor, release-confidence, and production-readiness metrics, using actionable insights to improve stability, delivery predictability, and business outcomes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience—and eight or more years of experience in quality assurance, quality engineering, testing, software delivery, or technical program delivery.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex QE initiatives across multiple applications, platforms, teams, vendors, and delivery timelines while influencing outcomes without direct reporting authority.
* Proven ability to develop integrated, risk-based test strategies spanning functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, automation, and production-readiness testing.
* Experience with Agile or hybrid delivery, quality governance, defect and release management, risk and dependency management, quality transformation, and executive-level metrics and reporting.
* Strong analytical, facilitation, organizational, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, resolve cross-team barriers, and drive work to completion.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting healthcare, insurance, claims processing, enrollment, payment, or Medicare platforms.
* Experience with large-scale implementations involving multiple internal applications and external vendor solutions.
* Experience supporting a Quality Engineering Program Management Office, testing center of excellence, portfolio governance function, or enterprise transformation program.
* Experience with automation frameworks and AI-assisted quality engineering.
* Knowledge of observability, monitoring, performance testing, production validation, and operational-readiness practices.
* Experience defining quality scorecards, release-confidence measures, vendor performance indicators, or QE maturity models.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience—and eight or more years of experience in quality assurance, quality engineering, testing, software delivery, or technical program delivery.

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$106,605.00 - $260,590.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

 
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

 
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/31/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.
