new_roles.title: Quality & Compliance Senior Manager
new_roles.description:
**About the Role:**

As a CBRE Quality and Compliance Sr. Manager, you will be responsible for supervising the team that supports quality assurance and quality control deliverables for large and high-profile clients.

This job is part of the Contract Quality Management job function. They are responsible for managing the delivery of contractual services to ensure requirements are fulfilled.

 

**What You’ll Do:**

* Provide formal supervision to employees. Monitor the training and development of staff. Conduct performance evaluations and coaching. Oversee the recruiting and hiring of new employees.
* Coordinate and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross-train staff. Set and track staff and department deadlines. Mentor and coach as needed.
* Execute both company and confidential client compliance programs and participate in continuous improvement objectives.
* Create initiatives and communicate issues across the functional areas. Report compliance status to key stakeholders and sr. management regularly.
* Manage the execution and evaluate the success of the quality-of-service initiatives for non-regulated services.
* Report Compliance (among other quality and business metrics) status to the client during review meetings; appropriately escalates and notifies CBRE and client management of quality and compliance issues.
* Oversee the inspection readiness program for the site. Manage audits as well as serve as the primary quality representative for operations.
* Apply a broad knowledge of the business, own discipline, and how own discipline integrates with others to achieve team and departmental objectives.
* Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Influence others to adopt a different point of view while being guided by policies and departmental plans.
* Identify and solve technical and operational problems of complexity.
* Understand and recognize the broader impact across the department.
* Improve and change existing methods, processes, and standards within job discipline.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 5 - 8 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
* Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention is preferred.
* Ability to lead the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations and handle problems.
* Leadership skills to motivate the team to achieve broad operational targets with impacts on own job discipline, multiple job disciplines, and department.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills and an advanced inquisitive mindset.

***Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.***

**Why CBRE?**

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

**AI Use Disclosure**

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills, and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the position is $160,000 annually and the maximum salary for the position is $180,000 annually. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. Successful candidates will also be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on CBRE’s applicable benefit program. This role will provide the following benefits: 401(K), Dental insurance, Health insurance, Life insurance, and Vision insurance.

 **Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE has a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law. 
 
**Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at +1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and +1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

new_roles.title: Director of Broadcast Operations and Programming Services
new_roles.description:
**SCOPE OF POSITION**

The Director of Broadcast Operations and Programming Services serves as the senior official responsible for oversight of the integrated day to-day broadcast and media distribution operations of WPSU; provides vision, strategic development and oversight of all content distribution across four broadcast television channels, three FM channels, works collaboratively in support of streaming and digital services; and serves as a member of the executive leadership team, providing strategic vision, key performance metrics, strategies and operational guidelines for the organization.

**MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**STRATEGIC LEADERSHIP**

* Serve as a member of the executive leadership team, providing strategic vision, key performance metrics, strategies and operational guidelines for the organization.

* Represent the organization's interests by regularly engaging in communications and negotiations with the Public Broadcasting Service, National Public Radio, the Federal Communications Commission and other organizations as necessary, and ensure compliance with the policies of those organizations.

* Regularly engage with key stakeholders including viewer/listeners, donors, advisory board members, businesses, and the community at large to build collaborative relationships and to cultivate awareness and support of the organization.

**OPERATIONAL OVERSIGHT**

* Oversee and manage the integrated day-to-day broadcast and media distribution operations of WPSU, ensuring compliance with federal and state laws and regulations, broadcast industry standards, WPSU policies, and safety guidelines.

* Oversee and manage program development and production, broadcast engineering and operations, regulatory compliance, and reporting.

* Ensure that the stations project an on-air image of high production values and quality of content and that all technical standards are regularly measured and met.

* Lead or assist in station development functions. Work to cultivate donor support for new projects and ongoing services. Conceive entrepreneurial projects to generate revenue. Identify funding sources and develop funding proposals.

**PROGRAMMING AND DISTRIBUTION**

* Responsible for the vision, strategic development and oversight of all content distribution across our four broadcast television channels, three FM channels and our digital services in order to drive audience growth, diversification, engagement, retention, and financial support.

* Implement a cross-platform strategy to acquire, produce and distribute diverse programming content that attracts, maintains, and increases audience, consistent with the organization’s mission and themes, and addresses issues of particular local relevance to the diverse communities we serve.

* Negotiate contracts for the acquisition and distribution of program content, manage and ensure compliance with all applicable terms, rights and releases.

* Respond to viewer and listener inquiries about programming.

**SUPERVISION**

* Provide direct supervision to the TV and FM broadcast operations, traffic, and programming staff, and the News Director.

* Ensure that applicable Human Resources and WPSU policies and procedures are followed. Work to identify and resolve related issues.

* Create and/or identify development opportunities for staff and training to enhance skills, leadership and foster growth.

* Lead and/or participate in interviewing and selection of new employees, work with supervisors, managers, and directors to set performance standards for staff and perform regular and ongoing review and evaluation.

* Foster and promote a team environment that celebrates and promotes a culture of diversity, safety and environmental consciousness.

**PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT**

* Remain competent and current in a rapidly evolving industry through self-directed professional reading, developing professional contacts with colleagues, attending professional development courses, presenting at conferences and engaging in other training and personal development opportunities.

**FINANCIAL**

* Oversee, develop and administer annual operating budgets that support our broadcast operations and administration, program acquisition, membership affiliation and more.

* Lead and/or participate in the planning and coordination of on-air fundraising campaigns as well as general WPSU fundraising efforts.

**Education:** Requires the knowledge obtained by receiving a Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline.

**Experience:** Proven leadership skills with a minimum of 4 years of experience directly supervising and managing staff. 5 or more years of full-time programming experience with knowledge of public media programs, audiences, editorial standards, and familiarity with ratings data.

**Technical Skills:** Must be technologically savvy, with fluent use of business software systems including Microsoft Office, (Word, Excel), and the ability to use content management systems and software tools. Experience with and capable of operating digital broadcast equipment required.

new_roles.title: Area Director, Operations - Business Optimization
new_roles.description:
I. Job Summary 
 
Provides business optimization and operations solutions leadership within the assigned operations group(s) and is recognized across the area for broad operations expertise. This Director level role is responsible for implementing optimization solutions to operations process issues and inefficiencies.
 
 
II. Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

* Works collaboratively with Operations Directors, HR, Safety, and Collections Leaders by contributing strategic vison and integrating a broad range of operation solutions services.
* Responsible for the successful execution and deliverance of operations business solutions in specific area(s) of responsibility. This includes responsibility for Operations Solutions Team budgets, performance achievement, specific objectives and stakeholder buy-in.
* Provides guidance and consistent communication of Operations Solutions strategy to all stakeholders.
* Considers operational performance and/or process and systems analyses and the recommended changes and understands the implications to the current and future operations environment.
* Will work to harmonize the work products and solutions produced within the Operations Solutions team with Operations Leaders and Partners.
* Coordinates and integrates Operations Solutions Centers of Expertise with a large scope and complexity within designated operating lines of business.
* Contributes a high level of expertise in business performance processes and systems analysis while considering the business implications to the current and future business environment.
* Responsible for providing support and guidance in the areas of Operation Solutions services such as Dispatch, Fleet operations, Operations Improvement, SDO/MSDO, Acquisition integration, Operations training programs.
* Works with internal and external customers, suppliers and other partners to resolve problems, respond to suggestions for improvement and enhancements, test, refine and institutionalize solutions.
* Drives designated operational area(s) toward achieving business results through operations solutions strategies.
* Responsible for developing and retaining talent to ensure that people with the right skills and motivations are in the right place at the right time to meet business needs.

 
III. Qualifications
 
 
A. Required Qualifications
 

* Bachelor's Degree (accredited) or in lieu of degree
* High School Diploma or GED (accredited)
* 4 years of relevant work experience
* 10+ years of previous related work experience (in addition to education requirements)

 
B. Preferred Qualifications 
 
 
 
IV. Physical Requirements 
 
Listed below are key points regarding physical demands, physical and occupational risks, and the work environment of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. 
Frequently 

* Repetitive Motions
* Eye/Hand/Foot Coordination
 
Constantly 
* Sitting
* Talking
Hearing 

* Office: This job primarily operates in a professional office environment and routinely requires the use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, copy machines, etc.

 
V. Benefits
 
At WM, each eligible employee receives a competitive total compensation package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and short-term disability. In addition, we offer a stock purchase plan, company matching on a 401(k), and more. Employees also receive paid vacation, holidays, and personal days. Please note that benefits may vary by site. 

If this sounds like the opportunity that you have been looking for, please click Apply.

new_roles.title: Senior Director, Back Operations - Collections - Remote
new_roles.description:
**Optum Insight** is improving the flow of health data and information to create a more connected system. We remove friction and drive alignment between care providers and payers, and ultimately consumers. Our deep expertise in the industry and innovative technology empower us to help organizations reduce costs while improving risk management, quality and revenue growth. Ready to help us deliver results that improve lives? Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Senior Director, Back Operations - Collections is the senior operational leader responsible for domestic hospital and professional collections performance across assigned client portfolios. This role directly leads the domestic collections organization and is accountable for cash acceleration, accounts receivable resolution, aging and inventory reduction, productivity, quality, workforce effectiveness, and achievement of client and operational commitments.

The Senior Director works closely with offshore/global delivery leadership to coordinate collections activities across domestic and global operations, including alignment of work allocation, performance expectations, quality standards, escalation pathways, and reporting.

In addition to direct responsibility for domestic collections, this position provides strategic and operational oversight across the broader back-end revenue cycle, including billing, global collections, denial management, and cash posting. These functions do not report directly to this position. The Senior Director is responsible for ensuring strong cross-functional coordination, identifying dependencies and barriers, facilitating resolution of issues impacting collections performance, and promoting accountability for overall back-end revenue cycle outcomes.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Domestic Collections Leadership and Performance
 + Provide direct leadership and accountability for domestic collections operations across hospital and professional accounts receivable portfolios
 + Lead a large, distributed organization through directors, managers, supervisors, and frontline collections teams
 + Own domestic collections performance related to cash, days in A/R, aging, inventory reduction, productivity, quality, cost to collect, service levels, and client commitments
 + Establish priorities for collections activities based on payer, aging, balance, account complexity, recovery opportunity, and client requirements
 + Ensure appropriate allocation of staffing and resources to maximize cash recovery and reduce unresolved A/R
 + Maintain disciplined management of aged, high-dollar, complex, and escalated inventories, including underpayments, stalled claims, administrative denials, payer escalations, and accounts requiring cross-functional intervention
 + Hold operational leaders accountable for established performance expectations and lead corrective action and performance recovery when results fall below targeted levels
* Global Collections Partnership
 + Partner closely with offshore/global collections leadership to align domestic and global collections activities
 + Establish consistent expectations for work allocation, work queues, productivity, quality, documentation, escalation, and performance reporting
 + Align domestic and global work based on account complexity, payer requirements, system access, client commitments, resource capabilities, and automation opportunities
 + Identify and resolve gaps in ownership, handoffs, and accountability that may impede collections performance
 + Maintain effective operating rhythms with global leadership to ensure visibility into performance, capacity, risks, and emerging client needs
* Back Operations Oversight and Integration
 + Provide strategic and operational oversight across billing, global collections, denial management, and cash posting, while maintaining direct leadership accountability for domestic collections
 + Partner with functional leaders to monitor performance, identify risks and dependencies, and address issues that may affect cash flow, aging, collections, or client commitments
 + Facilitate cross-functional resolution of issues involving billing delays, claim defects, denials, payment posting, payer behavior, system access, or workflow breakdowns
 + Establish clear mechanisms for escalating significant performance or operational barriers and monitoring remediation through resolution
 + Promote effective integration across back-end revenue cycle functions and appropriate accountability for end-to-end outcomes
 + Identify recurring operational issues and partner with appropriate revenue cycle leaders to address upstream and downstream root causes
* Performance Management and Analytics
 + Establish and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly operating rhythms, including performance reviews, dashboards, scorecards, forecasts, and corrective action plans
 + Monitor and manage key revenue cycle performance indicators, including cash collections, days in A/R, aging, inventory, productivity, quality, denial trends, cost to collect, staffing, and forecast performance
 + Analyze results by client, payer, account type, aging category, work queue, team, and other relevant dimensions to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
 + Establish transparent capacity and workforce plans that connect inventory, expected cash, productivity, staffing, training, attrition, and global delivery assumptions
 + Use data to distinguish performance issues driven by capacity from those caused by process, technology, payer behavior, access limitations, or upstream revenue cycle issues
 + Translate operational data into clear actions, priorities, and performance improvement plans
* Operational Excellence, Technology and Continuous Improvement
 + Identify opportunities to standardize and improve collections workflows, work queues, payer strategies, account segmentation, documentation practices, escalation processes, and operating procedures
 + Partner with Product, Technology, Analytics, and Automation teams to identify and prioritize opportunities to improve collections efficiency and effectiveness
 + Sponsor workflow redesign and automation initiatives that reduce manual activity, improve work prioritization, accelerate account resolution, and strengthen quality
 + Support appropriate adoption of analytics, predictive capabilities, automation, and AI-enabled tools within collections operations
 + Establish appropriate human review, exception handling, quality validation, and operational controls for automated processes
 + Identify recurring collections and denial root causes and partner with the appropriate operational leaders to address issues affecting revenue realization
* Client, Payer and Executive Leadership
 + Serve as the senior operational leader for domestic collections in discussions with client revenue cycle executives, internal executive leadership, and other key stakeholders
 + Lead client performance discussions, operational reviews, remediation planning, and executive escalations related to collections performance
 + Communicate operational performance, risks, root causes, corrective actions, and expected recovery timelines clearly and effectively
 + Coordinate payer escalation strategies when payer behavior contributes to significant payment delays, denials, underpayments, or administrative burden
 + Support new client transitions, expansions, and other operational initiatives involving collections or back-end revenue cycle capabilities
 + Partner across Finance, Client Management, Sales, Technology, Product, Human Capital, Compliance, and other operational functions to achieve client and organizational objectives
* People Leadership and Workforce Development
 + Build, develop, and retain a strong domestic collections leadership team, including directors, managers, supervisors, and emerging leaders
 + Oversee recruiting, selection, onboarding, training, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and retention strategies
 + Establish appropriate spans of control, role expectations, career pathways, and capability requirements based on operational complexity
 + Ensure leaders consistently communicate performance expectations, provide meaningful coaching and feedback, recognize strong performance, and address performance gaps in a timely manner
 + Foster a collaborative, inclusive, accountable, and performance-oriented culture across domestic teams and in partnership with global operations
 + Partner with Human Capital and other stakeholders on workforce planning, organizational change, employee relations, and other personnel matters
* Risk, Compliance and Operational Controls
 + Ensure collections activities comply with applicable federal and state requirements, payer requirements, contractual obligations, client policies, privacy requirements, and company controls
 + Maintain appropriate controls related to account handling, documentation, system access, quality, escalation, and other revenue cycle processes
 + Identify operational and compliance risks and ensure appropriate escalation and remediation
 + Partner with Compliance, Legal, Human Capital, and client leadership as appropriate to address identified risks

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of progressive healthcare revenue cycle experience
* 5+ years of experience in a leadership role with responsibility for operational performance
* 5+ years of experience leading accounts receivable follow-up and collections operations within a complex hospital, health system, physician, or outsourced revenue cycle environment
* 5+ years of experience leading large, geographically distributed teams through multiple levels of management
* 5+ years of experience managing operational performance using cash, A/R, aging, inventory, productivity, quality, staffing, and other key revenue cycle measures
* 5+ years of experience leading operational improvement, standardization, transformation, or performance recovery initiatives
* 5+ years of experience partnering with senior executives, clients, operational leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders
* 3+ years of experience working across domestic and offshore/global delivery environments

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience across both hospital/facility and professional revenue cycle operations
* 5+ years of experience leading complex, multi-client, or large health system revenue cycle operations
* 3+ years of experience working with Epic and/or other major EHR and patient accounting platforms
* 3+ years of experience leveraging workflow technology, analytics, automation, or AI-enabled capabilities to improve revenue cycle performance

* All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $159,300 - $273,200 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

**Application Deadline**: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare by harnessing technology and innovation to make care simpler to navigate, more affordable and more connected for the people we serve. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, valued, heard and respected, empowering people to bring their authentic selves to work and strengthening our collective impact through diverse talents, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.*

*UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.*

*UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.*

new_roles.title: Regional Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
Circle of Life is growing, and we have an opening for a Regional Director of Operations to join our team. This position will oversee and manage our New Mexico branches; Albuquerque, Gallup, Kirtland, Shiprock, and Zuni.

**Good for employees**

Circle of Life’s focus is creating a workplace where respect, appreciation and teamwork are the shared experiences of our team. We do good for our employees by collaborating on scheduling, a focus on wellbeing, a client-first directive, respecting and valuing every team member, having fun along with top industry compensation and benefits.

**Good deeds**

We also do good in our work. Our team of office and field staff care about each other and the clients we serve. We help one another. We care and provide for a wide range of patients with a focus on serving the underserved.

**Position duties include**

* Participate in the hiring and training of managers
* Organize and oversee the work and schedules of managers
* Conduct performance evaluations
* Handle discipline of employees as needed following company policy
* Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics, guidelines, and standards by which the company's efficiency and effectiveness can be evaluated (identify opportunities for improvement)
* Implement policies and procedures that will improve day-to-day operations
* Oversee office operations, ensuring each branch is reaching goals set by departmental and company leadership
* Monitors budget and revenue in each office to achieve financial objectives
* Communicates and explains new directives, policies/procedures to manager for change and meets with staff to explain changes, answer questions, and maintain morale
* Improve customer service and satisfaction
* Market current products to potential clients, families, case workers and potential referral sources
* Leads coordination and integration of efforts among homecare teams to produce smoother workflow and more cost-effective business processes
* Traveling is required

**Qualifications**

Qualified applicants will have 3 years of management experience, excellent verbal and written communication skills and interpersonal and customer service skills. Healthcare and/or home care experience preferred. The Regional Director of Operations oversees the day-to-day activities for their assigned branches, ensuring the organization is managed and performing efficiently and effectively. While carrying out the responsibilities of the position, ensure the values of servant-leadership, empathy, altruism, and integrity are evident in all actions and encounters.

**How good?**

* Positively change the lives of individuals and families in our communities
* Serve the underserved providing access to care for those who have been traditionally overlooked by the health care system
* Support a talented team of administrative and clinical professionals and be a part of a team that supports each other

**Full Benefits include**

* Medical, Dental, 401K, Paid Holidays, Top PTO Plan, Mileage, Flexible Schedules, Vision, Year-End Bonus

new_roles.title: Regional Director (EMS & NEMT Operations)
new_roles.description:
**Regional Director – EMS & NEMT Operations**

**Department:** Operations 
**Reports To:** Director of EMS Operations and Director of NEMT Operations 
**Territory:** Assigned Geographic Region – Multiple Branch Locations 
**Position Type:** Full-Time, Exempt (subject to applicable law) 
**Travel:** Regular regional travel required

**Position Summary**

The Regional Director – EMS & NEMT Operations is responsible for the overall operational performance, financial results, growth, staffing, leadership development, and service quality of Hospital to Home's EMS and Non-Emergency Medical Transportation divisions within their assigned region.

Reporting directly to both the Director of EMS Operations and Director of NEMT Operations, this position provides regional leadership and accountability for all transportation services within its territory, including ambulatory, wheelchair, and van stretcher transportation, as well as Basic Life Support (BLS), Advanced Life Support (ALS), ALS II, Critical Care Transport (CCT), and other specialized medical transportation services.

The Regional Director provides direct oversight and leadership to the General Managers within their assigned region, ensuring that each branch operates efficiently, meets established financial and operational goals, maintains appropriate staffing and fleet readiness, and delivers consistent, high-quality service.

This position serves as the primary operational link between corporate leadership and branch-level management, ensuring that company objectives, policies, financial expectations, and operational initiatives are effectively implemented throughout the region.

The Regional Director is expected to maintain a comprehensive understanding of both EMS and NEMT operations, recognizing the unique requirements of each service line while promoting consistency, collaboration, resource efficiency, and accountability across the region.

This is a hands-on leadership position requiring the ability to manage multiple geographically dispersed operations, develop effective management teams, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive sustainable growth across both divisions.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**1. Regional Operational Oversight**

* Direct and oversee all EMS and NEMT operations within the assigned region.
* Provide direct leadership, supervision, and accountability to Branch General Managers.
* Establish clear operational expectations and performance standards for each General Manager.
* Ensure consistent implementation of company policies, procedures, and operational initiatives across all assigned branches.
* Monitor daily transportation volume, staffing levels, fleet availability, service performance, and overall branch operations.
* Ensure each branch meets established operational, financial, productivity, and customer service objectives.
* Conduct regular branch visits, management meetings, and operational performance reviews.
* Identify operational deficiencies and develop and implement corrective action plans.
* Ensure appropriate operational coverage and readiness across both EMS and NEMT service lines.
* Coordinate resources between branches when necessary to accommodate transportation demand and operational challenges.
* Maintain consistent communication with both Directors regarding regional performance, operational concerns, staffing needs, and opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure that regional operations remain aligned with the overall strategic direction and expectations of Hospital to Home.

**2. Financial Accountability & Profitability**

* Take ownership of regional financial performance across both EMS and NEMT operations.
* Hold General Managers accountable for meeting established branch budgets and financial objectives.
* Monitor labor-to-revenue ratios, operating gross profit, overtime, fleet expenses, and other controllable operating costs.
* Review branch-level and service-line profitability on a regular basis.
* Identify financial trends, budget variances, and underperforming branches.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve profitability and operational efficiency.
* Ensure appropriate staffing and resource allocation to maximize productivity without compromising patient care or service quality.
* Work with the Directors of EMS and NEMT and Finance to develop and manage annual operating budgets.
* Monitor revenue production, transportation volume, labor utilization, and cost per transport.
* Ensure General Managers understand their financial responsibilities and can effectively manage the financial performance of their respective branches.

**3. Growth & Business Development Support**

* Drive transportation volume and revenue growth throughout the assigned region.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing EMS and NEMT services.
* Partner with Business Development and corporate leadership to support new contracts, customer relationships, and business opportunities.
* Ensure branches have the staffing, equipment, vehicles, and operational capacity necessary to support growth.
* Assist with the development and implementation of new service lines and operational initiatives.
* Support the opening, development, and integration of new branch locations and acquired operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve market presence and expand relationships with hospitals, health systems, skilled nursing facilities, transportation brokers, and other customers.
* Ensure growth initiatives are operationally sustainable and financially responsible.
* Work with General Managers to establish and execute branch-level growth strategies.

**4. Leadership & General Manager Development**

* Provide direct leadership, coaching, and accountability to all General Managers within the assigned region.
* Establish measurable performance expectations and regularly evaluate General Manager effectiveness.
* Develop management teams capable of independently operating successful and financially responsible branches.
* Hold General Managers accountable for financial performance, staffing, employee retention, service quality, compliance, and operational execution.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings and performance reviews with General Managers.
* Identify leadership development needs and provide coaching, mentorship, and additional training where necessary.
* Partner with Human Resources on recruiting, employee retention, succession planning, and management development.
* Address management performance deficiencies promptly and implement appropriate improvement plans.
* Ensure General Managers maintain appropriate oversight of their supervisors and field personnel.
* Promote a culture of accountability, professionalism, communication, teamwork, and employee engagement.
* Identify and develop potential future leaders within the region.
* Recognize strong management performance while addressing deficiencies that negatively impact branch operations.

**5. Staffing, Fleet & Resource Management**

* Monitor regional staffing levels, employee availability, overtime, turnover, and workforce productivity.
* Ensure branches maintain appropriate staffing for their respective EMS and NEMT service requirements.
* Work with General Managers, Scheduling, and Dispatch leadership to address staffing shortages and improve workforce utilization.
* Ensure EMS branches maintain adequate clinical staffing to support required levels of service, including EMTs, Advanced EMTs, Paramedics, and other necessary personnel.
* Ensure NEMT branches maintain appropriate staffing for ambulatory, wheelchair, and stretcher transportation services.
* Monitor fleet availability, vehicle utilization, maintenance schedules, and equipment readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve vehicle utilization and reduce unnecessary downtime.
* Work collaboratively with Fleet Management, Logistics, Scheduling, and Dispatch to ensure regional resources are deployed efficiently.
* Ensure vehicles and equipment are appropriate for the services being provided and meet applicable operational requirements.

**6. Service Quality & Customer Relationships**

* Maintain high standards of customer service, transportation reliability, and patient experience throughout the region.
* Monitor on-time performance, missed transports, cancellations, customer complaints, and service reliability.
* Ensure service failures are investigated and appropriate corrective actions are implemented.
* Support and maintain relationships with hospitals, health systems, skilled nursing facilities, transportation brokers, and other key customers.
* Partner with Business Development and corporate leadership to address customer concerns and support important customer relationships.
* Ensure General Managers maintain appropriate communication with customers and address service issues promptly.
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation coordination, hospital throughput, and overall customer satisfaction.
* Promote consistent service standards across all branches and service lines.

**7. Regulatory Compliance, Safety & Quality Assurance**

* Ensure regional operations comply with applicable federal, Virginia, Medicaid, EMS, NEMT, broker, and transportation requirements.
* Ensure General Managers maintain appropriate oversight of employee credentials, certifications, required training, and regulatory documentation.
* Work collaboratively with Compliance, Safety, Clinical Leadership, and the Medical Director to maintain operational readiness.
* Ensure EMS operations follow approved clinical protocols, applicable regulations, and established medical direction.
* Maintain appropriate separation between operational management authority and clinical decisions reserved for the Medical Director and authorized clinical personnel.
* Ensure NEMT operations comply with applicable transportation, driver qualification, vehicle, and service requirements.
* Monitor operational and patient safety incidents and ensure timely investigation, documentation, and corrective action.
* Support quality assurance initiatives and the implementation of corrective measures.
* Ensure branches maintain appropriate vehicle inspections, equipment readiness, and safety standards.
* Promote a regional culture of safety, regulatory compliance, and operational accountability.

**8. Corporate Communication & Strategic Execution**

* Serve as the primary operational representative for the assigned region.
* Maintain regular communication with both the Director of EMS Operations and Director of NEMT Operations.
* Provide accurate and timely updates regarding regional financial performance, operational challenges, staffing, customer concerns, and growth opportunities.
* Ensure corporate directives, policy changes, and operational initiatives are communicated and implemented effectively at the branch level.
* Participate in leadership meetings, budget reviews, strategic planning sessions, and operational performance meetings.
* Identify recurring challenges that may require corporate resources, policy changes, or additional support.
* Provide recommendations to improve operational consistency, profitability, and organizational effectiveness.
* Ensure General Managers remain informed of company expectations, organizational changes, and departmental initiatives.
* Promote collaboration between EMS and NEMT operations, identifying opportunities to share resources, improve efficiency, and eliminate unnecessary operational duplication.

**Key Performance Indicators**

The Regional Director will be evaluated on the overall performance of their assigned region across both EMS and NEMT operations.

The five primary performance categories include:

**KPI**

**Measurement**

Financial Performance

Actual versus approved budget, operating gross profit, labor-to-revenue performance, and branch profitability

Revenue Growth

Monthly revenue growth by branch and service line

Operational Productivity

Completed transports per vehicle, fleet utilization, employee productivity, and operational efficiency

Service Performance

On-time performance, completed transports, customer satisfaction, and service reliability

Leadership & Compliance

General Manager performance, staffing, overtime, retention, credentialing, and regulatory compliance

Performance will be evaluated at both the regional and individual branch levels, with separate reporting for EMS and NEMT service lines to ensure appropriate visibility into the performance of each division.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Minimum 5 years of transportation, EMS, healthcare, logistics, or related operations management experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple locations and geographically dispersed operational teams.
* Experience supervising managers and holding leadership teams accountable for performance.
* Strong financial management skills, including budget oversight, labor management, and profitability improvement.
* Proven ability to improve operational efficiency and drive sustainable business growth.
* Strong understanding of workforce management, fleet utilization, scheduling, and transportation operations.
* Excellent communication, leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple departments and service lines.
* Ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned region.

**Preferred**

* Experience in both EMS and Non-Emergency Medical Transportation operations.
* Current or previous EMT, Advanced EMT, or Paramedic certification.
* Experience managing BLS, ALS, Critical Care, wheelchair, and stretcher transportation services.
* Familiarity with Virginia Office of EMS requirements and applicable NEMT regulations.
* Experience managing large operational teams and multiple branch locations.
* Experience with financial reporting, operational analytics, and performance management systems.
* Experience with acquisitions, integrations, and organizational expansion.

**Authority & Accountability**

The Regional Director – EMS & NEMT Operations will have direct operational oversight of all assigned regional branches and their respective General Managers.

The position operates under the direction and authority of both the Director of EMS Operations and Director of NEMT Operations, with responsibilities spanning both divisions.

The Regional Director is accountable for:

* Overall operational performance of the assigned region.
* Financial performance, profitability, and budget adherence across both EMS and NEMT operations.
* Performance, development, and effectiveness of regional General Managers.
* Branch-level staffing, workforce productivity, and operational readiness.
* Fleet deployment, availability, and utilization.
* Transportation volume, revenue growth, and operational efficiency.
* Service reliability, patient experience, and customer satisfaction.
* Compliance with applicable operational, regulatory, and safety requirements.
* Successful implementation of corporate initiatives and operational directives.
* Identifying and addressing underperforming branches and management teams.
* Developing a strong, sustainable regional leadership structure.

The Regional Director is expected to exercise sound operational judgment and independently address routine regional challenges while appropriately escalating significant financial, personnel, regulatory, clinical, or operational concerns to the appropriate Director.

Clinical decisions and medical oversight remain under the authority of the Medical Director and designated Clinical Leadership.

**Reporting Structure**

**Director of EMS Operations** 
**Director of NEMT Operations** 
 
**Regional Director – EMS & NEMT Operations** 
 
**Branch General Managers** 
 
**Branch Supervisors and Support Personnel** 
 
**EMS and NEMT Field Personnel**

The Regional Director maintains a dual reporting relationship with the Director of EMS Operations and Director of NEMT Operations with the Director of EMS being their primary reporting manager. Both Directors provide departmental direction, establish expectations, and collaborate in evaluating regional performance.

**Overall Performance Expectations**

The Regional Director – EMS & NEMT Operations is expected to operate their assigned region with the accountability of a business leader, balancing financial performance, operational efficiency, employee development, patient safety, regulatory compliance, customer satisfaction, and sustainable growth.

This position requires a proactive, engaged, and results-oriented leader who can effectively manage General Managers, identify operational deficiencies, develop solutions, and ensure consistent execution of company objectives across multiple branches.

The successful Regional Director will understand that the performance of their region is ultimately a reflection of the effectiveness of its leadership team. They are expected to build capable General Managers, establish clear expectations, hold leadership accountable, and create an environment where each branch can operate successfully with appropriate oversight and support.

The position requires strong collaboration with both the Director of EMS Operations and Director of NEMT Operations, ensuring that the needs and objectives of both divisions are represented and effectively executed.

**Hospital to Home LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This job description describes the general responsibilities of the position and may be modified based on organizational needs.**

new_roles.title: Operations Director
new_roles.description:
**Position:** Operations Director

**Overview:**

The Operations Director oversees day-to-day operations across multiple departments, manages resources and people, and helps implement workflows to ensure Ambient Inks is running smoothly and in line with our strategic goals. This position requires an organized, systems-level thinker and someone confident in both their own leadership and management abilities. An emotional intelligence based approach to supervision, and an eye for developing and implementing complex processes, will serve this position well.

We like to bring on humans that have an interest in music, art, sustainability and are actively working towards improving the well-being of people and the planet. It’s important to us that whomever we hire backs our and thrives in a tight-knit, fast paced environment.

**Our Company:**

What started as a 2-human screen printing shop in a garage in 2009, has quickly evolved into an all encompassing artist merch design/production/management/fulfillment company based in Eau Claire, WI. We work with any array of artists from those that play house shows to artists touring the globe, along with various other clients that share our values. We’re committed to doing business in a way that puts people and planet first, a mindset that rethinks the impact merch can have on our world.

For more info about what we’re all about, check out our website.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

We are an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Employment at will:**

This position follows the employment at will standards.

**Ideal Start Date:**

December 2026

**Position Type: Full Time Salaried (40hr/week)**

This is a salaried position. The anticipated hours are Monday–Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm. Additional hours may be required at times.

**Compensation:**

The expected salary range for this position is $60k–$65k annually.

**Benefits:**

All full time positions (average 32–40 hours per week) receive:

* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Savings with up to a 4% employer match
* Profit Share Plan (This is structured as a year-end bonus plan that awards 20% of profits to staff, split equitably according to relative compensation of all members.)
* Paid Holidays (9 paid holidays per calendar year)
* Paid Time Off
* 1st Year – 1 hour earned per 32.5 hours worked (~8 day annual equivalent)
* 2nd Year – 1 hour earned per 23.5 hours worked (~11 day annual equivalent)
* 3rd Year+ – 1 hour earned per 18.5 hours worked (~14 day annual equivalent)
* Sick/Mental Health Time Off (5 days per calendar year)
* Paid Volunteer Time Off (3 days per calendar year)
* Maternity/Paternity/Adoption Leave (Eligible after 1 year of employment)
* Sabbatical Leave (Eligible after 10 years of employment)
* 20% off custom merch orders

**Primary Roles:**

*Please note, these roles are inclusive of working closely with many members of the team. Additional roles and responsibilities, as assigned.*

**Leadership / Company Culture:**

* Embodies our, and empowers staff to do the same. Provides insights and feedback on how we can continue evolving our philosophy and leadership/operations responsibilities as we grow

* Works out of our Eau Claire location regularly to allow for greater engagement with staff, and better understand the day-to-day operations of Production, Logistics, and Fulfillment

* Cultivates an environment in which staff feel supported, heard, appreciated, and fulfilled through compassionate and direct engagement. This is done in many ways, such as supporting staff with challenges across their projects, their well general being, their professional and personal growth, sharing appreciation, signing birthday cards, celebrating workivesaries and other wins, spontaneous and formal check-ins, etc.

* Offers ideas and helps to implement ways to improve the well being and culture of the company, to continue fostering a conscious and compassionate environment

* Represents the company and our philosophy in larger group settings, such as participating in Fambient hangs/outings, live printing events, and community/volunteer opportunities

* Actively strives to bring a sense of togetherness amongst departments and our staff, whether that be together as a group, or by making an effort to get to know each staff member, individually

* Shares their sympathy when life, family, and personal matters arise, and provides additional support with their work responsibilities as needed

* Provides day-to-day support on the production and webstore floor as needed, in order to stay connected with staff and continually develop a holistic understanding of the company

* Continuously learns and refines conscious leadership skills through podcasts, books, conferences, seminars, and other resources, and shares insights with Managers and Leadership level positions to support collaborative growth

* Understands Ambient Inks on a deep level, including its philosophy, staff/positions, roster, products, services, and provides ideas to continually improve our operations

* Maintains personal accountability, is timely, efficient, organized, precise, proactive, thorough, and collaborative in how they work, and models these attributes to staff

**Operations, Workflow & Systems Improvement**

* Oversees day-to-day operations within Production, Logistics, and Fulfillment, ensuring our clients are satisfied and our products are meeting Ambient Inks’ standards

* Helps to establish benchmarks and goals for the various departments, and supports in the achievement of those goals

* Thinks innovatively on how to improve systems, processes, and policies company-wide in an effort to achieve our goals

* Works with Account Managers to address procedural issues and collaborate to solve problems

* Collaborates with leadership on how to improve efficiencies and create better systems/workflows within their department. Works with leadership to establish goals and holds them accountable for ensuring new systems are implemented and executed, and that goals are being met

* Supports leadership with any major disruptions, errors, or other critical issues. Helps problem solve and works collaboratively on solutions. Brings recurring issues, or those that have large financial impact, to the Managing Director for additional support

* Maintains a consistent pulse on the various departments to ensure they’re functioning well and addresses issues before they become urgent

* Assists Managing Director on building-related needs and interfaces with landlords when necessary

**Management, Leadership Support & Backups**

new_roles.title: Director of Production
new_roles.description:
MHI Ship Repair & Services is a major marine repair and conversion contractor serving the U.S. Navy, Military Sealift Command, Maritime Administration and Commercial ship owners and operators worldwide. Our shipyard is conveniently located in the Mid-Atlantic region at the port of Hampton Roads, Norfolk Virginia.

**JOB SUMMARY:** Manages the operations of all production trades to include Facilities and Gas Free. Responsible for ensuring that all projects are manned with competent, properly trained and certified personnel, and the work efforts are coordinated and executed in a cost-effective manner, safely, and on time. Provides leadership and guidance to Shop Superintendants and oversees the maintenance and improvement of all shop equipment and development of shop procedures.

**SUPERVISES:** All Shop Superintendents

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Primary oversight of all production departments to include Facilities and Gas Free. Responsible for making strategic and tactical decisions related to certain aspects of MHI's production business to include operation non-Program work
* Responsible for ensuring that all projects are manned with competent, properly trained and certified personnel, and that work efforts are prioritized, coordinated and efforts integrated between departments and executed safely, in a cost-effective manner and on time.
* Ensures performance is within the guidelines of the contracts, delivery orders are received and that all contractual requirements are within the scope of work for the specific market and are met for U.S. Navy, Government, private shipyard, and commercial projects.
* Holds daily production meetings with all trades and Project Managers. Communicate with all department heads to ensure that any manning, scheduling, tooling, and material issues are identified and resolved.
* Attend all SRA Production Meetings.
* Walks through all in plant vessels daily verifying all work in progress and identifying and resolving any issues as they arise.
* Provides leadership and guidance to Shop Superintendants and oversees the maintenance and improvement of all shop equipment and development of shop procedures.
* Reviews and proofreads specs.

**ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Estimating as requested.
* May on occasion be required to manage a project.
* Performs other related duties as assigned by supervisor.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* College education and 15 years progressive experience in the maritime industry. (Apprenticeship and practical experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.) Prior management experience a must.
* Ability to estimate.
* Basic knowledge of all skilled trades, and ability to manage effectively.
* Ability to communicate effectively as a leader.

MHI Ship Repair & Services offers competitive wages and an excellent benefit package.

Affirmative Action/EOE Employer of protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

new_roles.title: Senior Director - Operations
new_roles.description:
As a Senior Director - Operations you will be responsible for the performance of all operational functions of a large, complex location, or multiple remote locations. You will provide strategic leadership to meet and optimize established levels of business performance objectives, service, productivity, and quality. You will partner with leaders across supply chain, operations, and the business units to drive continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Set strategic goals for operational efficiency and increased productivity.
* Lead team to ensure objectives are met, including driving customer service excellence plans, setting and managing performance targets, and employee performance management.
* Partner with Lean Leadership, ensuring LEAN methodologies are utilized and action plans are developed to correct problem areas and optimize established levels of business performance objectives, service, productivity, and quality
* Ensures consistent compliance with standard operating procedures, policies, internal audit controls, Sarbanes-Oxley controls, and business management quality system requirements
* Analyze current operational processes and performance, recommending solutions for improvement when necessary.
* Identifies market potential through competitor analysis and strategic planning.
* Develops annual business plans, identifies key activities, and priorities.
* Implements and communicates operational strategies and solutions consistent with business plans.
* Provides guidance to operations management in hiring and developing talent.
* Ensures operational excellence goals and audit requirements are met.
* Partners with inventory leaders to ensure region inventory needs and goals are met.
* Provides guidance to ensure business continuity and recovery plans are met.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree preferred
* LEAN yellow belt certification
* 10+ years of operations leadership experience
* Experience running large, complex location or multiple remote locations
* Business and management principles, including strategic planning and resource allocation.
* Strategic thinking skills and ability to work with senior management and regional teams.
* Ability to streamline and implement new structures and roles that create speed, efficiency, and support rapidly shifting business demands
* In depth knowledge of diverse business functions and principles (e.g. supply chain, finance, customer service etc.)
* Working knowledge of data analysis and performance/operation metrics
* Strong decision-making and problem solving skills.
* Strong analytical skills.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to influence and lead change in a cross-functional team environment.
* Ability to travel 25% - 50% of the time.

 

Compensation Details $164,391 - $226,037 Annually

 

This amount is what we reasonably believe we will pay for the position; however, offer amounts may vary based on factors such as geographic location, relevant education, experience, qualifications, skills, shift, or any collective bargaining agreements. 
 
For eligible positions, compensation may include participation in a bonus or sales incentive plan, subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plan documents. For certain sales roles, Wesco also offers a commission structure that provides additional compensation based on sales results, as defined by the applicable commission plan.

In addition, Wesco offers a benefits program for eligible employees, which may include paid time off, medical, dental, and vision coverage, and retirement savings plans. Additional details about benefits are available here .

 

At Wesco, we build, connect, power and protect the world. As a leading provider of business-to-business distribution, logistics services and supply chain solutions, we create a world that you can depend on. 
 
Our Company’s greatest asset is our people. Wesco is committed to fostering a workplace where every individual is respected, valued, and empowered to succeed. We promote a culture that is grounded in teamwork and respect. With a workforce of over 20,000 people worldwide, we embrace the unique perspectives each person brings. Through comprehensive benefits and active community engagement, we create an environment where every team member has the opportunity to thrive. 
 
Learn more about Working at Wesco here and apply online today!

new_roles.description:
Multi-Unit General Manager

**District Kitchen & Bar + PUBLIC eat+drink** 
Berkshire County, Massachusetts

Compensation

**$130,000–$160,000 total compensation** (base salary + performance bonus)

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Multi-Unit General Manager to oversee two established, high-volume independent restaurants in the Berkshires. This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives on building strong teams, driving profitability, implementing systems, and creating operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is equal parts operator, coach, and business strategist. You'll work directly with ownership to improve performance across both locations while ensuring exceptional guest experiences and a strong workplace culture.

Key Objectives

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Growing top-line revenue
* Increasing restaurant profitability
* Reducing controllable costs
* Implementing scalable systems and procedures
* Developing and retaining high-performing managers
* Improving accountability and operational consistency
* Strengthening guest satisfaction and online reputation

ResponsibilitiesBusiness Performance

* Own P&L performance for both restaurants
* Analyze financial results and identify opportunities for revenue growth and margin improvement
* Develop and execute plans to increase sales, traffic, and guest frequency
* Monitor labor, food, beverage, and operating costs
* Establish measurable KPIs and hold management teams accountable

Leadership & Team Development

* Recruit, hire, train, and develop management staff as needed
* Create a culture of accountability, professionalism, and hospitality
* Conduct regular performance reviews and coaching sessions
* Build leadership depth within both organizations
* Resolve employee issues quickly and professionally

Operations

* Ensure consistent execution of service, food quality, and hospitality standards
* Standardize systems and procedures across both locations where appropriate
* Oversee scheduling, staffing levels, inventory controls, and purchasing
* Improve efficiency and eliminate operational bottlenecks
* Maintain compliance with all health, safety, labor, and licensing requirements

Revenue Growth

* Partner with ownership on marketing and promotional initiatives
* Identify opportunities to increase guest counts, check averages, and repeat business
* Oversee private events, catering opportunities, and community partnerships
* Evaluate menu performance and pricing strategies alongside culinary leadership

Qualifications

* 5+ years of senior restaurant management experience
* Multi-unit management experience strongly preferred
* Demonstrated success improving restaurant profitability
* Strong financial acumen with deep understanding of P&L management
* Experience managing managers and building leadership teams
* Proven ability to create systems, processes, and accountability structures
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Hospitality-first mindset combined with strong business discipline

Ideal Candidate

You are:

* Highly accountable and results-oriented
* Comfortable making difficult decisions
* Analytical and data-driven
* Skilled at motivating teams and developing leaders
* Focused on continuous improvement
* Equally comfortable in the dining room, the kitchen, and the financial statements

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation package of $130,000–$160,000 annually
* Significant performance-based bonus opportunity
* High level of autonomy and decision-making authority
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on two well-established restaurants
* Direct partnership with ownership on strategy and growth initiatives

To Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief note outlining:

* Your multi-unit management experience
* A specific example of improving profitability at a restaurant operation
* Why this opportunity interests you

Pay: $130,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
