Why LeoLabs?

At LeoLabs, we're building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements daily on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO). Our radar-powered intelligence protects billions in assets, monitors adversarial behavior, and ensures safe operations for commercial and government missions.

We're not just building technology, we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space. As orbital activity accelerates and threats grow more complex, LeoLabs is a trusted partner for Space Domain Awareness, Space Traffic Management, and Satellite Operations for top-tier space operators and allied defense organizations.

If you're looking to work on mission-critical challenges at the forefront of aerospace, national security, and AI, your impact starts here.

LeoLabs is seeking a Head of Manufacturing to lead the next phase of production scaling of our radar systems. This leader will own the manufacturing strategy, industrialization roadmap, quality management, facility scaling, and cross-functional execution required to increase production capacity beyond 10x. This role may be leveled as Senior Director or Vice President level based on the successful candidate’s experience, leadership scope and demonstrated ability to own the function. The role with report directly to the SVP, Radars. This role is a full-time, in-person position based at our headquarters in Menlo Park, CA. Regular domestic travel is expected.

The Head of Manufacturing will turn LeoLabs’ advanced radar designs from low/medium-rate initial production into repeatable, scalable, high-rate production systems. You will collaborate with and leverage support from Product, Supply Chain, Radar Systems and Hardware Engineering, Program Management, Finance and Accounting, and executive leadership to build the manufacturing capacity that enables LeoLabs to deploy radar systems more reliably and at greater scale for the U.S. Government, allies, and commercial customers.

The preferred candidate has done this before – they are a leader who has built and sustained a manufacturing system, rather than someone who has only managed an existing operation. This candidate is a hands-on manufacturing executive or emerging executive from a high-performance production environment such as aerospace, defense technology, automotive, or other complex hardware industries. They have scaled production systems from the ground up, built functional teams, improved quality, stood up facilities or production lines, and operated with urgency in environments where reliability, repeatability, and mission success matter.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Strategy & Scale

* Own LeoLabs’ high-rate manufacturing and industrialization strategy for radar systems, subsystems, and associated high-reliability hardware across manufacturing, assembly, integration, and test operations.
* Build and scale a production system and team capable of supporting 10x growth in radar production over the next 2 years while maintaining high standards for quality, reliability, integration, and deployment readiness.
* Define the operating model across internal manufacturing, external suppliers, contract manufacturing, and integration partners.
* Own the high-rate production footprint plan including facility needs, equipment, tooling, staffing, and capital investment.
* Stand up scalable production lines, work cells, fixtures, test stations, documentation, and acceptance processes for radar hardware, RF systems, electronics, electromechanical assemblies, power systems, compute infrastructure, and system-level integration.
* Establish the scaled manufacturing steady state including production planning, throughput management, capacity planning, cost analysis, quality, and delivery execution.

Industrialization

* Own the transition from engineering builds to production-ready designs.
* Establish and mature release and readiness gates, first-article processes, and build documentation.
* Partner with Radar Systems and Hardware Engineering teams to industrialize new radar designs, ensuring manufacturability, testability, serviceability, configuration control, and production readiness.
* Partner with engineering NPI manufacturing team to improve manufacturability, DfX, and cost reduction opportunities.
* Ensure new radar products have validated build plans, test procedures, tooling, factory acceptance testing criteria, and supplier plans before production ramp.
* Create a functioning feedback system from manufacturing and sustainment back into product and engineering.

Quality, Reliability & Production

* Build and mature the quality management system required for high-reliability radar systems serving mission-critical customers.
* Establish clear standards for configuration control, traceability, inspection, nonconformance management, corrective action, supplier quality, and production acceptance.
* Drive measurable improvements in yield, first-pass quality, rework, scrap, field defects, and schedule performance.
* Build strong review mechanisms for failures, escapes, production risks, and systemic issues.
* Partner with Technical Program Management to align production readiness and execution with program, contract, customer, and deployment commitments
* Partner with Supply Chain on supplier readiness, long-lead planning, cost reduction, and risk mitigation.
* Partner with the Radar Operations Center and Global Infrastructure to turn field performance and maintenance data into product and process improvements to increase performance, reduce operational impacts, and decrease maintenance costs.
* Develop manufacturing KPIs and high-level dashboards for throughput, schedule metrics, yield, labor tracking, cost, quality, rework, scrap, supplier performance, and field reliability.

Team Leadership

* Establish and lead the LeoLabs Production System, creating a common operating model for safety, quality, delivery, cost and people. Implement tiered daily management, visual controls, standard work, structured problem solving, leader standard work, production flow, capacity management and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, develop, and lead a world-class manufacturing organization including manufacturing operations, production, test operations, quality, facilities, and related functions.
* Set clear ownership and metrics across the manufacturing organization.
* Build a culture of execution, urgency, accountability, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

* 15+ years of experience in manufacturing, production operations, industrialization, factory operations, manufacturing engineering, or related operational leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and leading a mature Lean manufacturing or production operating system, such as the Toyota Production System, including standard work, visual management, daily accountability, structured problem solving, flow, built-in quality, waste reduction and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated experience scaling production capacity, standing up production lines or facilities, and improving throughput, quality, cost, and delivery performance.
* Experience manufacturing complex, high-reliability hardware in industries such as aerospace, defense, automotive, advanced electronics, robotics, industrial automation, energy systems, RF systems, communications, space systems, or mission-critical infrastructure.
* Experience with quality management systems and standards such as AS9100, ISO 9001, IPC standards, ESD controls, supplier quality, first-article inspection
* Strong technical fluency with hardware product development, NPI, configuration control, test operations, production readiness, and root-cause corrective action.
* Excellent communication, leadership, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Eligibility to obtain and maintain required U.S. security clearances, as applicable to this role.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, industrial engineering, supply chain, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

* Formal training or demonstrated practitioner experience in Toyota Production System, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Lean Six Sigma or an equivalent operating system. Black Belt, Master Black Belt, TPS practitioner/trainer or comparable credentials preferred.
* Experience developing greenfield or brownfield production facilities, production lines, integration sites, or manufacturing cells.
* Experience with radar, RF systems, antennas, communications systems, sensors, satellites, ground systems, aerospace systems, or other complex electromechanical products.
* Experience supporting Department of War, Space Force, NASA, or allied government customers.
* Experience working with classified, export-controlled, ITAR/EAR-controlled, or otherwise sensitive hardware programs.
* Master’s degree in engineering, operations, business administration, manufacturing, supply chain, or a related discipline.

Compensation

This position is benchmarked to San Francisco Bay Area with a base salary range of $225,000 - $248,000, plus bonus, equity, and benefits.

Compensation Note: The salary range for this position is benchmarked based on the designated primary work location for the role. Final compensation may vary depending on the selected candidate’s work location, applicable market data, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Perks and Benefits

* Global workforce: flexible remote/hybrid opportunities
* Work on complex, meaningful missions with real-world impact
* Unlimited paid time off for most roles
* Competitive salary and equity packages
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
* Access to the forefront of commercial space operations and defense innovation

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International

Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the

U.S. Department of State. More information regarding ITAR can be found at DDTC's website.

The Director of Corporate Quality & Compliance is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously improving the company's Quality Management Systems (QMS), regulatory compliance, and overall quality performance across multiple manufacturing locations.

This role provides strategic leadership for corporate and site-level Quality functions, ensuring compliance with industry standards, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory requirements while driving a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

* Lead and maintain the company's Quality Management Systems across all manufacturing locations, including ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and AS9100.
* Establish and execute the corporate quality strategy, including certification planning, QMS development, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FDA regulations and requirements for medical device products and manufacturing processes.
* Oversee manufacturing process validation, including IQ/OQ/PQ, process controls, change management, calibration, and product traceability.
* Lead customer, supplier, internal, and certification audits, ensuring effective corrective actions and ongoing compliance.
* Develop and maintain strong customer quality relationships, leading quality reviews, escalations, and corrective action initiatives.
* Oversee Supplier Quality Management, including supplier qualification, performance monitoring, audits, and corrective actions.
* Drive company-wide quality performance through KPIs, CAPA, 8D, root cause analysis, and risk management.
* Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Six Sigma, 5S, waste reduction, and process optimization.
* Lead and develop Site Quality Managers, Supplier Quality Engineers, and Customer Quality Engineers across multiple locations.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Purchasing, and other departments to identify systemic issues and improve product and process quality.
* Promote a proactive quality culture focused on prevention, risk management, customer satisfaction, and accountability.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of Quality experience in electronics manufacturing, PCB assembly, or contract manufacturing, including 5+ years leading Quality teams.
* Working knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 13485, AS9100, and applicable FDA regulations, with experience leading AS9100 implementation and ongoing compliance.

* Experience managing customer quality, supplier quality, audits, and corrective action (8D, CAPA, root cause analysis).

* Experience leading multi-site Quality organizations.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

**About Blue Origin**  
We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. These positions will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable spaceflight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin's vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.

  

As a Sr. Director for Manufacturing at Blue Origin’s manufacturing, production, and launch facilities, this role will have a direct impact on the success of Blue’s mission.

We are looking for senior leaders to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required.

  

**About This Opportunity**  
Blue Origin is actively building its senior manufacturing and operations leadership team across multiple sites. We are seeking an experienced Sr. Director with a strong aerospace background to lead high-performing teams in support of our rocket production program. This role will span the following functional areas:

Manufacturing and Integration
  
Provides senior leadership across production operations including structural fabrication, thermal protection systems, systems integration, testing, and final assembly for Blue Origin’s booster manufacturing. Responsible for establishing and maintaining process controls, driving production efficiency, and ensuring safe, repeatable spaceflight hardware delivery at all stages of the product lifecycle. This role will also provide leadership across integration operations supporting the assembly and verification of complex space systems, launch vehicles, and propulsion hardware. Accountable for coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure the safe, on-time integration of hardware in alignment with engineering requirements, mission assurance standards, and program milestones.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
Leaders across these functional areas are expected to:
  

* Lead and develop teams of Managers, Senior Managers, and Directors driving manufacturing and operations execution across space and propulsion programs
* Champion a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement across all functional teams
* Own departmental KPIs, budgets, staffing plans, and capital project portfolios
* Partner with Program Management, Site Leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders to meet production schedules and customer expectations
* Drive process definition, development, deployment, and improvement initiatives including Lean Manufacturing and root cause analysis
* Collaborate with engineering teams to advance Design for Manufacturability principles and accelerate the transition from development to production
* Implement and mature production frameworks that support world-class manufacturing capabilities
* Communicate and enforce mission assurance and safety principles throughout the organization
* Recruit, develop, coach, and mentor talent at all levels of the organization

  
**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Aerospace, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience
* 15 or more years of progressive experience in aerospace manufacturing or a closely related industry, such as launch vehicles, aircraft, spacecraft systems, or defense
* 5 or more years in a senior leadership role managing managers and large, cross-functional teams
* Demonstrated experience leading manufacturing and operations teams in fast-paced, complex environments

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Master's degree, MBA, or advanced degree in a relevant engineering or business field
* Prior experience in aerospace environments supporting space hardware, rocket propulsion, or other mission-critical, high-value components
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, the Toyota Production System, or Six Sigma; Black Belt certification preferred
* Experience transitioning manufacturing capabilities from development and prototyping into full-rate production
* Knowledge of fabrication processes including machining, welding, composites, additive manufacturing, cleaning, and non-destructive testing
* Experience with facility activation, new production line startup, or multi-site manufacturing operations
* Proficiency with MRP/ERP, PLM, and Manufacturing Execution Systems

  

Base Pay Range for:

WA applicants is $203,165.00 - $284,430.30

**Other site ranges may differ**

  

**Culture Statement**

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

  

**Export Control Regulations**

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

  

**Background Check**

* Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical  

  

**Benefits**

* Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
* Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
* Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.

Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws.

  

**Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation**

Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com . The Plant Manager drives operational discipline, team performance, and continuous improvement to deliver consistent, predictable results.

  

**Company Overview:**

PTA Plastics, an employee-owned and innovative leader in the plastic injection molding, contract manufacturing and tool-building industry, is looking for a Plant Manager to join our dynamic team.

At PTA Plastics, we’re more than just a manufacturer; we partner with Fortune 500 OEMs in the medical device, defense, homeland security, and technology sectors, constantly pushing the boundaries of product development and manufacturing excellence. * Control overtime, scrap, and operating expenses

* Ensure schedule attainment and on-time delivery

* Drive production efficiency, uptime, and throughput

* Remove operational roadblocks quickly

* Lead and resolve customer escalations at the plant level

  

**Safety & Compliance**

* Own plant safety performance

* Ensure compliance with OSHA, environmental, and company standards

* Drive a proactive, behavior-based safety culture

  

**People Leadership & Culture**

* Lead and develop plant leadership team and floor personnel

* Drive accountability, performance management, and clear expectations

* Build a high-performance, no-excuses culture

  

**Execution of Corporate Quality Standards**

* Ensure adherence to corporate Quality Management System (QMS)

* Support and enforce corrective actions

* Hold production teams accountable for quality at the source

  

**Execution of Corporate Engineering Standards**

* Maintain schedule discipline and production alignment with planning

* Resolve plant-level material and supply issues

* Support inventory control and flow

  

**Cross Functional Alignment**

* Corporate Quality

* Corporate Engineering

* Corporate Supply Chain

* Corporate HR

  

**Continuous Improvement**

* Lead Lean and continuous improvement initiatives

* Reduce scrap, downtime, and inefficiencies

* Improve labor utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)

  

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

#### **Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or a related field required (or equivalent combination of education and experience)
* 7–10+ years of manufacturing experience, preferably in injection molding or a similar high-volume, process-driven environment
* 3–5+ years of leadership experience managing production teams and plant operations
* Proven track record of delivering results in:
  + Production output and schedule attainment
  + Cost control and labor efficiency
  + Safety and quality performance
* Experience leading in a metrics-driven environment (OEE, scrap, uptime, etc.)
* Hands-on experience with Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and waste reduction initiatives
* Experience working within structured corporate environments with cross-functional support (Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, HR)
* Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems and production planning processes

#### **Technical & Industry Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, including production processes, workflow optimization, and plant performance metrics (OEE, uptime, scrap, labor efficiency)

* Working knowledge of injection molding processes, materials, tooling, and secondary operations (or similar high-volume manufacturing processes)

* Understanding of maintenance and reliability principles, including preventive maintenance and equipment uptime optimization

* Experience with Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and waste reduction methodologies (5S, Kaizen, standard work, etc.)

* Knowledge of quality systems and practices, including root cause analysis, corrective actions, and adherence to QMS standards (ISO or similar)

* Familiarity with production scheduling, capacity planning, and inventory flow within an ERP/MRP environment

* Understanding of workplace safety standards and regulatory compliance (OSHA, environmental requirements)

* Ability to interpret and act on operational data to drive performance improvements

  

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to stand, walk, and move around the production floor for extended periods.
* Capable of lifting and carrying heavy objects weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Manual dexterity and hand-eye coordination for handling small tools, machine components, and molds.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Comfortable wearing personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety glasses, gloves, and ear protection.
* Occasional bending, kneeling, and reaching to access equipment and perform maintenance tasks.
* Good vision and color perception for inspecting parts and identifying any defects or abnormalities.
* Ability to work in temperature-controlled environments and withstand exposure to noise levels associated with manufacturing machinery.
* Ability to receive, comprehend and utilize required training from OSHA and Company including but not limited to the following:
* Hazard Communication
* Lock Out/Tag Out

Employing state-of-the-art robotics, precision welding equipment, and automated machining processes, Dexter has achieved over 65 years of success through a commitment to the principles of superior quality, continuous improvement, and unparalleled customer service.

For more information about our company, access Dexter's web site at www.dextergroup.com.

The Plant Manager is the overall leader of the site and business operations. In this role, the Plant Manager directs operations in accordance with the company’s operational imperatives, principles, policies, and procedures as well as:

* Continuously promotes and grows a culture of Safety.
* Drives commitment to quality throughout the operation, assuring excellence in customer service.
* Promotes an environment of trust, employee involvement, and engagement.
* Provides direction, leadership, and development to managers and supervisors.
* Develops annual budget, monthly forecasts, and gap analysis of financial performance.
* Budgets and manages capital expenditures.
* Champions continuous improvement.
* Develops plans for efficient use of materials, machines, and employees.
* Reviews production costs and product quality.
* Modifies production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance the operation.
* Implements programs to assure the operation maintains compliance with local, state, and federal regulations in all areas.

**Overview:**

* Lead and drive the success of the health, safety, quality, and financial performance of the plant.
* Model operational rigor through daily/weekly/monthly rhythms to provide direction of clear goals and objectives for production areas.
* Responsible for ensuring all direct and indirect employees understand their personal role in achieving company standards.
* Demonstrate and maintain the standard of impeccable integrity
* Foster plant Safety, Quality and Production successes along with continuous improvement to create new ways in which to operate the business better.
* Foster and develop an environment of Zero Accidents.
* Achieve and maintain On Time Delivery of 98% or better.
* Partner with Corporate support resources to develop processes that improve the overall working environment, enhance Safety, and drive productivity for the shop operations.
* Build and nurture a culture in which challenges and opportunities exist for all employees based on individual capabilities and initiative.

**Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related discipline and 10 years’ experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

English, Spanish as second language preferred

* Full benefits package including Health, Dental, Vision, Life, STD, LTD, FSA, HSA

* 401(k) Plan with company contributions
* Paid Holidays and paid time off
* Opportunities for internal career development and growth

**Role Summary**

Parklane is opening a brand-new manufacturing facility in Michigan, and we are looking for a Plant Manager to work with us to build it from the ground up. As the senior leader on site, you will have accountability for the plant: safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, and culture. You will lead a team of up to 150 employees and be supported by Parklane’s shared services groups, including Engineering, Supply Chain, Human Resources, and Finance, so you can focus on running a safe, high-performing operation and setting the standard for how Parklane operates in Michigan.

**Key Responsibilities**

Site Leadership & Start-Up

* Own the overall performance of the Michigan facility, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, and cost
* Lead the ramp-up of the new site, establishing operating rhythms, processes, and standards aligned with Parklane’s practices
* Develop and execute site plans and budgets in partnership with Finance and senior leadership
* Serve as the face of Parklane in the local community, with customers, vendors, and regulators

Operations & Production

* Direct day-to-day manufacturing, fabrication, assembly, and shipping activities to meet customer commitments
* Work with production scheduling and Supply Chain to balance capacity, labor, and material availability
* Drive continuous improvement and lean practices to improve throughput, reduce waste, and control cost
* Track and report on site KPIs, and act quickly on gaps to plan

Safety, Quality & Compliance

* Champion a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and applicable federal, state, and local requirements
* Partner with QHSE to implement and sustain Parklane’s quality management system and drive corrective actions to closure
* Maintain a clean, organized, audit-ready facility and well-maintained equipment

People Leadership

* Recruit, develop, and lead plant leaders, supervisors, and front-line teams, building a strong bench for a growing site
* Partner with Human Resources on hiring, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, and engagement
* Set clear expectations, coach for accountability, and recognize results in line with Parklane’s core values
* Build a positive, inclusive culture where employees feel safe, respected, and invested in the site’s success

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Engineering on product design, manufacturability, and technical issues
* Partner with Supply Chain on procurement, inventory, logistics, and supplier performance
* Collaborate with Finance on budgeting, cost control, and financial reporting
* Leverage shared services across the organization to support the site efficiently, and provide feedback to continuously improve that support

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 8+ years of progressive manufacturing operations experience, including 3+ years in a plant management or senior site leadership role
* Proven experience leading a workforce of 100+ in a manufacturing or fabrication environment
* Experience launching, expanding, or transforming a facility is a strong asset
* Strong working knowledge of lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and quality systems (ISO 9001 exposure preferred)
* Solid understanding of OSHA and workplace safety, environmental, and employment regulations in the U.S.
* Financial acumen, including budgeting, P&L awareness, and cost management
* Experience with ERP systems and data-driven performance management (D365 an asset)
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills, with the ability to influence across a matrixed organization
* Hands-on, accountable, and comfortable building structure in a fast-paced, evolving environment

**About Parklane**

As one of North America’s leading providers of turnkey mechanical noise control and VIRS solutions, Parklane is on a constant search for top industry talent. Every day we help clients with their sound attenuation and vibration challenges. We do it by leveraging an agile approach to engineering, product manufacturing and implementation.

As an organization, we live and breathe our core values:

1. Challenge Accepted

2. Work Hard & Play Hard

3. Share the Wins & Own the Losses, and

4. Build Together, Grow Together

By sharing ideas and supporting each other at every turn, we’ve built a reputation both for service excellence and the strength of our workplace culture. Put simply, our team is committed to doing whatever it takes to help our customers succeed—and that’s why we need professionals with the experience and expertise to solve complex problems.

Pay: $125,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

Responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and continuous improvement of a specialized magnet wire manufacturing plant. Directs all plant operations to achieve excellence in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and employee engagement. Leads cross-functional teams across production, maintenance, engineering, quality, supply chain, and human resources to ensure reliable operations, compliance with regulatory requirements, and achievement of business objectives. The ideal candidate brings strong manufacturing leadership experience, a disciplined approach to problem-solving, and a proven ability to build a high-performance culture in a fast-paced industrial environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead all plant operations with full accountability for safety, environmental compliance, quality, productivity, delivery performance, and cost management.
* Drive a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with OSHA, environmental regulations, company policies, and safe work practices; lead incident prevention, investigation, and corrective actions.
* Oversee the production of magnet wire products, including coordination of drawing, annealing, insulating, enameling, winding, packaging, and related support processes, as applicable to the facility.
* Ensure production schedules are achieved while maintaining customer specifications, quality standards, and on-time delivery requirements.
* Direct plant leadership across production, maintenance, engineering, quality, warehousing, and support functions to achieve operational goals.
* Develop and execute plant operating plans, budgets, capital plans, and continuous improvement initiatives aligned with company strategy.

* Ensure preventive and predictive maintenance systems are effective and that critical equipment reliability is sustained.
* Support new product introductions, process changes, and capital projects to improve capacity, quality, and operational performance.
* Build a culture of accountability, teamwork, communication, and employee involvement through visible leadership and regular plant presence.
* Hire, coach, develop, and evaluate plant leadership and workforce talent to strengthen bench depth and succession planning.

* Strong knowledge of lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and structured problem-solving methods.
* Experience with budgeting, financial performance management, and capital planning.
* Strong leadership, communication, coaching, and team development skills.
* Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make sound operational decisions.
* Working knowledge of quality systems, process control, and manufacturing compliance requirements.
* Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems and standard business software.

At Radius Packaging, our relentless focus on innovation and operational excellence is just one of the reasons our customers enjoy working with us. Our unique company culture, progressive leadership, and dedicated members mean that who we are is just as important as what we do.

For fifty years, we've had fun supplying plastic packaging for diverse consumer and commercial markets. Our members take pride in creating and delivering products they care about, going the extra mile to help our customers and our business succeed. From containers for food, beverage, and personal care products to household and industrial chemicals, Radius Packaging continues to enhance our capabilities as a full-scope packaging provider. Based in New Berlin, Wisconsin, with a second facility in Delavan, we have approximately 260 members.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated **Plant Manager** to lead our New Berlin manufacturing facility. Reporting to the Director of Manufacturing, this leader is responsible for the overall performance of the facility across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, People Development, Maintenance, and Continuous Improvement, with accountability for plant P&L performance and operational execution.

We're looking for more than someone who can manage today's production. We want a leader who thinks ahead, prevents problems before they occur, builds strong systems and processes, and ensures improvements are sustained.

The ideal candidate brings a strong engineering and systems-thinking mindset, understands the financial drivers of manufacturing performance, communicates effectively at all levels, and knows how to create accountability while developing and recognizing a high-performing team.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Lead Plant Performance**

* Provide overall leadership for plant operations, including safety, quality, production, maintenance, delivery, cost, food safety, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and manage key performance indicators for safety, quality, delivery, OEE, labor productivity, cost, equipment reliability, and member engagement.
* Maintain a visible, practical, hands-on leadership presence throughout the facility.
* Bring urgency to plant and equipment performance while proactively addressing risks that could affect safety, quality, delivery, cost, or customer commitments.

### **Build Systems That Prevent Problems**

* Build, implement, and sustain prevention-focused systems and processes that improve operational consistency, equipment reliability, product quality, and financial performance.
* Use strong engineering and systems thinking to assess performance and solve complex operational challenges.
* Lead structured root-cause analysis and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented, verified for effectiveness, and sustained.
* Partner with plant leadership to strengthen predictive and preventive maintenance strategies that reduce unplanned downtime and improve equipment reliability.

### **Own Financial & Operational Results**

* Own plant P&L performance, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, labor utilization, operating expenses, maintenance spending, and capital investment planning.
* Direct plant activities and coordinate priorities across functions to achieve manufacturing and customer objectives in a timely and cost-effective manner.
* Manage facilities, capital assets, and equipment utilization while identifying opportunities for repair, replacement, automation, and capital improvement.

### **Drive Accountability & Continuous Improvement**

* Create disciplined action plans with clear owners, due dates, review processes, and escalation through completion.
* Lead Lean, continuous improvement, and 6S efforts and ensure improvements are incorporated into standard work and sustained over time.
* Promote accountability while recognizing individuals and teams who meet commitments, improve performance, and demonstrate strong ownership.

### **Develop Great People**

* Build, lead, and develop a capable, engaged, and high-performing team.
* Lead effective hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and recognition.
* Create alignment across departments and organizational levels through clear, proactive communication.
* Support cross-functional priorities and build strong partnerships throughout the organization.

### **Champion Safety, Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with established safety, health, quality, GMP, food safety, food quality, Company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
* Foster an environment where safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement are part of how work gets done every day.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, Business, or a related field.
* At least 8 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including responsibility for plant operations or multiple operational functions.
* Proven experience leading managers, supervisors, and cross-functional teams in a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated P&L accountability, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, capital planning, and financial performance management.
* Strong engineering, technical, and systems-thinking capabilities with demonstrated success identifying, solving, and preventing operational issues.
* Experience leading root-cause analysis and implementing sustainable corrective and preventive actions.

* Proven ability to build, develop, engage, and retain high-performing teams.

### **Description**

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled **Plant Manager** to oversee and manage all aspects of multi-site plant operations, ensuring efficient production, high-quality standards, and a safe working environment.  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, proven experience in managing manufacturing plants, and a thorough understanding of operational strategies, including safety, budgeting, and human resource management. The Plant Manager will also be responsible for ensuring production goals are met, maintaining plant facilities, and continuously improving processes to maximize efficiency

### **How You Will Help**

  

* Lead and manage daily operations of the manufacturing plant to meet production schedules, ensure product quality, and achieve on-time delivery.
* Partner with EHS to ensure safety, health, and environmental regulations, including local, state, and federal safety standards.
* Develop and implement strategic plans for operational efficiency, resource allocation, and process improvements.
* Manage plant budgets and financial statements, ensuring cost-effective operations while meeting financial goals.
* Maintain and upgrade plant facilities and equipment, ensuring they are in optimal working condition; oversee necessary repairs, replacements, and adjustments.
* Monitor production activities, ensuring adherence to quality standards and safety protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Collaborate with engineering, quality, and supply chain teams to optimize production processes and implement lean manufacturing principles.
* Create and foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement, leading by example and building strong relationships with team members.
* Implement and monitor inventory management strategies, ensuring proper material flow and minimizing waste.
* Develop, mentor, and manage staff, providing training and development opportunities to enhance skills and performance.
* Ensure timely communication and coordination between departments to meet production targets and business objectives.
* Identify and resolve operational issues, making data-driven decisions to improve plant efficiency and productivity.
* Perform other duties as assigned by senior management
* Travel up to 10% domestically, including quarterly visits to company facilities in Pennsylvania and Texas to support project execution and cross-functional collaboration.

  

### **What You Will Bring**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience working in a custom manufacturing environment, including knowledge of assembly, fabrication, welding, and machining processes
* A minimum of 10 years of experience in plant operations, with at least 5 years in a management role.
* Working knowledge of budgeting, strategic planning, and financial statements.
* Strong leadership abilities with proven experience in team building, decision-making, and people management.

More than 175 years later, that heritage lives in ASC Engineered Solutions, a comprehensive pipe preparation, joining, hanging and flow-management portfolio supporting the people who build and maintain commercial buildings, industrial facilities, infrastructure, and critical systems. A house of brands, Anvil, Gruvlok, Sharpe, SCI, and ABZ, unified as ASC in 2019, and the portfolio has grown in the years since.

In 1920, Reliable Automatic Sprinkler started doing one thing exceptionally well: building the fire safety systems that protect people and property. Sprinklers, valves, and accessories, made in the United States. More than a century later, the discipline has not changed. A century of American-made fire protection products, with multi-generational customer relationships and multi-decade specifications. A century of protecting what matters the most.

**Two legacies. One Future.**

existing_roles.title: Director of Technical Operations
existing_roles.description:
### **Description**

At Pacific Seafood, we do more than just provide the world with the healthiest proteins on the planet. We are a family-owned, excellence-driven organization committed to being the brand of choice in the marketplace and the employer of choice in the community. We believe in servant leadership, investing in our team members’ personal and professional growth, and rewarding performance. We live by the core values of our Diamond Philosophy: Teamwork, Productivity, Quality, and Excellence—which means consistently doing your best and *always* striving to do better.
  
  
**Summary:**

We are seeking a dynamic, solutions-oriented **Director of Technology Operations** to lead, scale, and optimize IT operations for our enterprise. Serving as a strategic partner to leadership and business unit heads across geographies, this role is accountable for the reliability, agility, and continuous evolution of our enterprise technology ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a transformative, hands-on leader who blends deep technical fluency with strong financial stewardship and operational maturity. Rather than introducing rigid bureaucracy, this leader takes a pragmatic, evolutionary approach—fine-tuning existing workflows, aligning IT service delivery with measurable business outcomes, and fostering an empowering, "Best in Class" culture across Service Desk, Project Management Office (PMO), Infrastructure, and Enterprise Applications.

Because our team members are our greatest asset and strength, this role directly assesses the VP’s direct reports and the next level of leaders, identifies strengths and gaps, and ensures each leader has a practical development plan. The Director also evaluates reporting relationships, spans of control, role clarity, and succession depth, and uses a working knowledge of income statements and balance sheets to connect people decisions to business results.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise IT Service Delivery & Service Desk Operations**

* **Support Leadership:** Direct the strategy and daily execution of end-user support, including the IT Service Desk, Desktop Support, Field Services, Depot/Procurement, and VIP/Executive Support across multiple time zones.
* **SLA & Throughput Excellence:** Establish, monitor, and enforce aggressive Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure consistent, predictable service throughput—even during critical end-of-month, end-of-quarter, or high-volume operational periods.
* **End-to-End Lifecycle Management:** Oversee the complete IT lifecycle of internal and customer-facing systems, including enterprise workstations, telephony, infrastructure, and specialized operational/manufacturing hardware.
* **Operational Readiness & Business Continuity:** Lead contingency planning, risk surfacing, and operational readiness initiatives to protect business continuity and minimize disruptions during organizational transitions or major system cutovers.

**2. ITSM, ITIL Frameworks & IT Governance**

* **ITSM & ITIL Maturity:** Own, design, and continuously optimize core ITIL processes—including Incident, Problem, Request, Change, Escalation, and Knowledge Management—within enterprise platforms.
* **IT Intake & Demand Management:** Architect and govern a centralized IT Intake process to evaluate, prioritize, and route incoming business requests, ensuring resource allocation aligns with strategic corporate objectives and operational capacity.
* **Enterprise Governance & Compliance:** Establish pragmatic IT governance models, internal controls, and compliance frameworks that safeguard enterprise data and infrastructure without impeding business agility.
* **Knowledge & Self-Service Enablement:** Drive continuous improvement in knowledge base creation, documentation standards, and automated self-service tools to empower end-users and accelerate first-contact resolution.

**3. Project Management Office (PMO) & Digital Transformation**

* **PMO Leadership & Tollgate Governance:** Develop, deploy, and oversee formalized project management methodologies and tools. Serve as the executive tollgate for technology initiatives to ensure requirements are rigorously defined, scoped, and aligned with strategic goals.
* **Enterprise System Implementations:** Lead cross-functional execution for major digital transformation initiatives, including ERP migrations, CRM rollouts, and M&A technology integrations.
* **AI & Automation Readiness:** Champion the pragmatic adoption of emerging technologies and AI-driven workflows across IT operations to automate routine tasks, enhance reporting accuracy, and elevate enterprise productivity.

**4. Continuous Improvement & Lean Operations**

* **Lean Six Sigma Execution:** Embed Lean and Continuous Improvement methodologies into daily IT operations to eliminate waste, reduce turnaround times, and streamline cross-departmental workflows.
* **Root Cause & Corrective Action:** Partner closely with all IT Operations teams on deep failure-mode analysis and root-cause corrective actions to permanently resolve recurring technical issues and business impacts.
* **Asset & Inventory Optimization:** Reframe IT hardware, spare parts, and demo/recon pools as actively managed operational assets—optimizing space utilization, procurement costing, redistribution, and lifecycle disposition.

**5. Customer Satisfaction & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* **Customer-Centric Culture:** Champion an unwavering focus on internal and external customer satisfaction, transforming IT from a transactional support function into a proactive, trusted business enabler.
* **Executive & Departmental Alignment:** Foster transparent, collaborative partnerships with Finance, Manufacturing, Distribution, Quality, Engineering, and Sales leadership to ensure technology roadmaps directly support revenue and operational goals.
* **Voice of the Customer:** Implement regular satisfaction tracking, feedback loops, and executive business reviews to measure stakeholder sentiment and drive targeted service enhancements.

**6. Financial Stewardship & Resource Optimization**

* **Multi-Million-Dollar P&L Management:** Develop, justify, and manage a $15M–$30M+ IT operations budget, maintaining strict fiscal discipline across OPEX, CAPEX, vendor contracts, and software licensing.
* **Data-Driven Economics:** Apply rigorous cost-benefit and repair-versus-replace analyses to hardware maintenance, vendor agreements, and service models, identifying opportunities to reduce operational costs while improving service quality.
* **Vendor & Outsourced Partner Management:** Negotiate and manage contracts with third-party vendors, hardware suppliers, and managed service providers to ensure accountability and maximum return on investment.

**7. Talent Development & Organizational Leadership**

* **Inspirational People Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and coach a diverse, geographically dispersed organization of managers, engineers, analysts, and technicians.
* **Cross-Training & Team Resilience:** Eliminate single-point dependencies by building structured cross-training programs, clear career pathways, and flexible skill coverage across teams.
* **High-Accountability & Morale:** Cultivate a high-morale, low-turnover environment rooted in psychological safety, diversity, equity, and inclusion, while holding staff to clear performance standards through active coaching and accountability.

  

### **What you bring to Pacific Seafood**

**Required:**

* **Executive or Senior Leadership Track Record:** 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in IT Operations, Service Delivery, or Technical Operations, including 5+ years at the Director or Senior level within a complex, multi-site, or enterprise environment.
* **Proven Operational Impact:** Demonstrated history of scaling support teams, managing multi-million-dollar budgets, and delivering measurable reductions in operational costs and ticket turnaround times.
* **Enterprise Transformation:** Hands-on experience leading large-scale ERP/CRM transitions, ITIL/ITSM framework implementations, and post-M&A systems integration.
* **Cross-Industry Fluency:** Strong operational understanding of corporate IT alongside manufacturing, distribution, engineering, or field-service environments.

**Education & Certifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related technical discipline. Preferred; advanced degrees, e.g., Master of Business Administration (MBA)

**Certifications, not required, but highly desired:**

* ITIL Certification
* Lean Six Sigma Certification
* Project Management Professional or active PMI affiliation strongly preferred.

**Physical Requirements**  
  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a team member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the team member:

* Must be available to work Monday -Friday during regular working hours, with occasional weekend duties.
* Ability to maintain a stationary position 80% of the time, with intermittent walking, standing, bending, reaching, and/or crawling.
* Ability to move and transport documents, equipment, or other items weighing up to 50 pounds across various locations for different team members, departments, and events.

### **Benefits**

At Pacific Seafood your base wage is only a portion of your overall compensation package. We invest in our Team Members through a comprehensive and attractive total rewards package, including but not limited to:

Pacific Seafood is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

existing_roles.description:
Since 2018, Elevate Aircraft Seating has been enhancing the passenger experience through innovative aircraft seat design and manufacturing. With locations in California, Washington, and Germany we are guided by creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Customer Quality Manager to join our team in Charleston, South Carolina. This is an on-site position based in Charleston, South Carolina. We value teamwork, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, and we offer competitive benefits along with opportunities for growth.

**Export Control Requirements:**

**This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager of Customer Quality serves as the primary quality liaison between Elevate Aircraft Seating's manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring effective communication, timely resolution of quality issues, and alignment with customer and regulatory requirements. This highly visible, customer-facing position is responsible for leading defect investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action coordination while driving quality improvements back into manufacturing operations to prevent recurring issues and strengthen product conformity. The Senior Manager of Customer Quality partners cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and customer stakeholders to drive accountability, proactively address quality concerns, and strengthen customer relationships. This position also provides executive leadership with data-driven reporting on quality performance, emerging risks, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives to support informed decision-making and operational excellence.

**SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES** - **Essential Functions****(Other duties and projects may be assigned or requested.)**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential*

**Customer Quality Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary quality liaison between Elevate manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring alignment on quality concerns, operational priorities, and resolution activities.
* Lead customer-facing quality discussions, providing technically accurate information, objective evidence, and clear communication regarding product conformity, nonconformances, and corrective actions.
* Establish and maintain structured communication cadences with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely escalation, consistent messaging, and accountability for quality-related issues.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive engagement, effective problem-solving, and timely resolution of quality concerns.

**Defect Management & Technical Quality Assurance**

* Lead the investigation, documentation, and resolution of product defects and nonconformances, identifying root causes, points of origin, and appropriate corrective actions across manufacturing, receiving inspection, and final assembly operations.
* Evaluate reported nonconformances against applicable Letters of Conformance (LOCs), approved craftsmanship documentation, engineering specifications, and customer requirements to ensure accurate defect classification and resolution.
* Partner with Boeing and internal Quality and Engineering teams on corrective action investigations, providing technical analysis, objective evidence, and recommendations to support effective resolution.
* Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of aircraft interior products, functionality, design requirements, and installation processes to effectively evaluate quality concerns and communicate technical findings.
* Coordinate appropriate inspection and acceptance testing support during aircraft installation activities, including verification of electrical connections, mechanical functionality, and applicable acceptance test procedures (ATP).

**Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure customer-facing quality activities align with applicable FAA/EASA regulations, AS9100 standards, customer specifications, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
* Maintain accurate, traceable quality documentation and defect records through established systems, including SharePoint, ensuring appropriate stakeholders have access to current information and supporting evidence.
* Coordinate the communication and implementation of applicable service bulletins, engineering changes, and product effectivity requirements across manufacturing locations, OSS, Boeing, and customers.
* Support customer quality reviews, audits, and regulatory compliance activities by providing technical documentation, investigation findings, and corrective action evidence.

**Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive cross-functional corrective and preventive action initiatives to address customer quality concerns, eliminate recurring defects, and strengthen manufacturing process effectiveness.
* Translate customer quality feedback, defect trends, and investigation findings into actionable improvement opportunities for manufacturing, Engineering, and Quality teams.
* Apply root cause analysis, statistical methods, and structured problem-solving techniques to validate defect origins, assess corrective action effectiveness, and support sustainable improvements.
* Identify emerging quality risks and recurring issues, proactively escalating concerns and coordinating mitigation activities to minimize customer impact and prevent recurrence.

**Executive Reporting & Cross-Functional Quality Performance**

* Develop and present quality performance reports, defect trends, corrective action status, and emerging risks to executive leadership, providing data-driven insights and recommendations to support operational decision-making.
* Establish and monitor key quality performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer defects, resolution timelines, recurring issues, and corrective action effectiveness.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and OSS teams to drive accountability, coordinate issue resolution, and ensure timely implementation of quality improvements across affected operations.
* Monitor customer quality deliverables, open issues, and corrective action commitments to ensure alignment with program milestones, customer expectations, and organizational quality objectives.

**Other**

* Maintain a safe, secure and legal work environment, adhering to all Company policies and procedures.
* Protect the confidentiality of the Company’s information and products.
* Contribute to team efforts by performing other job-related duties and projects as assigned or requested.

**GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS – Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field is required.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in quality assurance, quality engineering, or quality management within aerospace manufacturing or a related highly regulated industry.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and present quality performance metrics, defect trends, corrective action status, and risk assessments to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Proven track record of leading cross-functional quality improvement initiatives, influencing stakeholders without direct authority, and translating customer quality concerns into sustainable manufacturing improvements.
* Extensive background in defect investigations, root cause analysis, nonconformance management, and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) across manufacturing and customer operations.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a primary quality interface with customers, including managing complex quality concerns, presenting technical findings, and driving issue resolution.
* Minimum of 5 years working with aerospace quality standards, FAA/EASA regulatory requirements, product conformity, and applicable customer quality requirements.

**Skills:**

* In-depth knowledge of AS9100 standards, FAA/EASA regulations, aerospace quality requirements, product conformity, and applicable airworthiness standards.
* Strong technical understanding of aircraft interior products, manufacturing processes, installation requirements, and quality documentation, including Letters of Conformance (LOCs) and approved craftsmanship standards.
* Advanced proficiency in nonconformance management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and evidence-based defect investigation and resolution.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to present complex technical findings, resolve customer concerns, and influence internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret quality data, identify trends, evaluate risks, and present actionable recommendations to executive leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, establish structured communication processes, drive accountability, and implement sustainable quality improvements without direct supervisory authority.

**Preferred Skills/Experience:**

* Familiarity with Boeing quality requirements, customer-specific specifications, craftsmanship standards, and aircraft final assembly or onsite support operations.
* Formal training or practical experience conducting customer, regulatory, or third-party quality audits within the aerospace industry.
* Working knowledge of advanced quality methodologies, including APQP, FMEA, Statistical Process Control (SPC), and AS9145 requirements.
* Proficiency in AS9102 First Article Inspection (FAI) requirements, Material Review Board (MRB) processes, and aerospace product conformity documentation.
* Knowledge of aircraft interior systems, including seating, electrical and mechanical functionality, installation processes, and acceptance testing procedures (ATP).

**Other:**

* Extended or irregular hours may be required.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.
* Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.
* Elevate Aircraft Seating is an “at-will” employer; employment is at the mutual consent of both the employee and the employer, and may be terminated at will for any reason, with or without cause, at any time during employment with the Company.
* As business conditions warrant a change in the operating necessities of the Company, all employees are expected to react productively, handle other essential tasks assigned now or in the future.
* Tasks may vary slightly based on products produced at a division.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES AND LICENSE**

* N/A

**SUPERVISION PROVIDED TO THE POSITION**

* Direction is provided for assignments in terms of desired outcome (goals), timing and budget.
* Work is reviewed or measured in terms of meeting organizational objectives and schedules.

**LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITY**

* Oversee the work of others.
* Assist with coordination of adherence to organizational goals, operating policies, and budgetary guidelines.

**PROBLEM SOLVING**

* Develop and provide solutions to complex problems based on established precedents and are consistent with organization objectives.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**  
*Elevate Aircraft Seating offers competitive wages and benefits to recognize employees for their work. The base pay offered will vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, location, experience and take into account internal equity.*

* Affordable health care plans for yourself and your family
* And so much more!

(MNAe). **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** *(To perform within this position successfully, the incumbent must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned.)*

* Represent the Quality Control function in executive reviews, customer meetings, supplier escalations, audits, and other strategic business discussions.
* Promote a proactive quality culture, continuous improvement, customer focus, supplier accountability, and workplace safety.
* Define decision-making and escalation authority and make timely quality decisions, including containment, production hold, shipment hold, sorting, rework, and controlled release recommendations when required.
* Supervise, coach, and develop Quality Control HOSs, managers, Assistant Managers, Specialists, and other assigned quality personnel.
* Evaluate departmental capability, workload, staffing, competency, and training needs and allocate resources based on business and quality risk.

* Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, internal policies, and applicable quality requirements.
* Develop and continuously improve quality management systems, procedures, standards, inspection controls, traceability, rework controls, NCR processes, Quality Alerts, and escalation processes.
* Review and approve daily, weekly, and monthly departmental quality reports, quality trends, KPIs, recurring issue analysis, and improvement priorities.
* Report quality performance, significant risks, customer and supplier escalations, resource needs, and recovery status directly to the CEO and executive management.

* Communicate directly with suppliers and oversee supplier quality activities, including supplier containment, investigation, corrective action, response status, escalation, and closure.
* Oversee containment, affected-scope determination, traceability, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and effectiveness verification.
* Ensure issues are properly classified as internal process, supplier, design, logistics, or customer-interface related and assign clear ownership for resolution.
* Lead and approve major investigations involving internal defects, supplier-related issues, customer complaints, field concerns, and quality escalations.
* Direct MIP process quality, supplier quality, and customer quality activities across Stator, Motor, Reducer, PE System, Inverter, and related electrified powertrain products.
* Direct overall process and customer quality management for outsourced ICCU and HPCU production, including outsourcing-partner performance, process controls, change points, audits, defect trends, containment, corrective actions, escalation, and effectiveness verification.
* Establish and execute departmental quality strategy, objectives, policies, governance, priorities, and performance indicators aligned with company business objectives.
* Lead the company's overall quality management activities covering internal manufacturing processes, supplied components, finished products, and OEM customer interfaces.

**Required Knowledge, SkillsAbilities:**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word.
* Working knowledge of IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, audit management, traceability, containment, and change control.

* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and escalation-management skills for interaction with the CEO, executive management, OEM customers, suppliers, and cross-functional leaders.
* Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills using 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, and corrective action effectiveness verification.
* Ability to evaluate complex quality risks from company-wide, customer, supplier, financial, operational, and business-continuity perspectives.
* Broad working knowledge of internal process quality, supplier quality, customer quality, quality systems, and automotive manufacturing operations.
* Strong executive leadership, organizational management, people development, and decision-making capabilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word, and other business applications.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

Yes. Provides overall leadership and direction for the PE Quality Control Department, including MIP process quality, supplier quality, and OEM customer quality activities. Supervises assigned quality leaders and personnel and is responsible for work direction, priority setting, resource allocation, coaching, performance feedback, organizational capability, and escalation management in accordance with company policy.

***QUALIFICATIONS***

**Required EducationExperience:**

* Bachelor's Degree from an accredited institution.
* Five (5) years of leadership experience managing quality teams, cross-functional investigations, and major customer and/or supplier escalations.

* Bachelor's Degree or more advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

* Experience managing customer claims, supplier escalations, major containment activities, audits, and executive-level quality reporting preferred.
* Experience leading internal process quality, supplier quality, and OEM customer quality organizations preferred.
